jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager - DTC & Creative for a U.S marketing agency
jobs.description:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to gifted people, regardless of location.

About the Client

Our client is a multi-brand e-commerce and digital marketing business focused on growing brands through channels such as TikTok Shop, creators and affiliates, Meta Ads, Shopify, Amazon, and organic social. The company operates in a fast-moving environment where multiple brands, campaigns, and marketing functions need to stay aligned. This role is focused on bringing structure, accountability, and operational efficiency to that growth environment.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Project Manager to bring structure, organization, and accountability to projects across our marketing and creative teams. Operating across multiple brands, departments, and marketing channels, we need someone who is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple priorities and moving pieces simultaneously.
This person will ensure projects stay aligned and on track by establishing clear deliverables, ownership, timelines, and priorities. They will help the team maintain visibility, follow through on commitments, and identify potential blockers before they become problems.

We are not looking for a generic corporate Project Manager.
We want someone who has been close to marketing, creative, DTC, creators, paid media, e-commerce, or agency work
and understands the pace and complexity of this environment. Experience simply managing tickets, scheduling
meetings, or updating project boards is not enough. The ideal candidate has worked somewhere with multiple
brands, campaigns, departments, and deadlines moving at the same time - and knows how to bring order to that
environment.

Responsibilities

* Manage multiple projects across multiple brands and departments
* Create clear timelines, deliverables, owners, priorities, and deadlines
* Keep projects and team members aligned, accountable, and on track
* Follow up on outstanding tasks and make sure important work gets completed
* Identify blockers, missed handoffs, and potential delays before they become problems
* Keep leadership updated on project status, priorities, and risks
* Improve internal processes, workflows, and organization
* Coordinate across marketing, creative, creators, paid media, social, e-commerce, and leadership
* Help ensure launches, campaigns, and important deadlines do not fall through the cracks

AREAS YOU WILL WORK ACROSS:
• TikTok Shop • UGC & creative strategy
• TikTok creators / affiliates • Trybe / creator programs
• Shopify • Organic social / social management
• Meta Ads • Creative production
• Amazon • Product launches & campaigns
* You do not need to personally execute every channel, but you should understand how modern digital marketing and
creative teams operate.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
* Everyone knows what they are responsible for and what matters most
* Priorities and deadlines are clear and visible
* Leadership can quickly understand where projects stand
* Blockers are identified early instead of becoming last-minute emergencies
* Teams communicate and execute effectively across departments
* Processes continuously improve as the company grows
* The organization becomes more structured without becoming slower or overly corporate

Requirements

3+ years of project management, marketing operations, or similar experience
Experience in an agency, multi-brand company, DTC brand, performance marketing agency, or similar environment
Comfortable managing many projects, stakeholders, and deadlines at the same time
Understands digital marketing and creative workflows
Extremely organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and strong at follow-up
Can hold people accountable while maintaining strong working relationships
Can identify inefficiencies and help improve systems and processes
Comfortable with changing priorities and a fast-moving environment
Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Notion, or similar tools

jobs.description:
About Propelled Brands Franchising, LLC

Propelled Brands® is the multi-brand platform company under which service industry franchise brands operate and grow. We are excited to propel brands forward. We know franchising, we love franchisees, and we have a supportive, motivating culture. Our current brands are FASTSIGNS®, My Salon Suite®, and Camp Bow Wow®.

What We Offer

At Propelled Brands, our total rewards package is a direct reflection of our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent. Our benefits are built on the foundation of our core values: Make it Happen, Expertise and Mastery, Positive Attitude, Growth Mindset, and being Considerate. As a member of our team, you will find a supportive environment with rewards designed to help you thrive.

Employer sponsored medical and dental plans
Voluntary benefits such as vision, critical illness, accident, and pet insurance
100% Employer sponsored Short-Term Disability, Long-term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance
Retirement Savings employer match up to 3% and 100% vested
Generous paid time off policies
Paid Parental Leave for mothers and fathers

About The Opportunity

The Project Manager manages FASTSIGNS National Accounts sign projects from initial inquiry through completion. This role partners with customers, FASTSIGNS franchisees, vendors, subcontractors, landlords, and internal teams to deliver exceptional service while keeping projects organized, on schedule, and within established requirements.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Project Intake & Planning

Receive and review new project inquiries and orders through email, catalogs, purchase orders, and other channels.
Ensure all necessary project information is received and accurately documented.
Enter new jobs into the project management system and create scopes of work for new installs, build-and-ship projects, and service work.

Vendor, Survey & Compliance Coordination

Research and select qualified FASTSIGNS franchisees or subcontractors to perform surveys and complete project work.
Verify current vendor insurance coverage and issue purchase orders as needed.
Research applicable sign codes, municipal requirements, landlord criteria, insurance requirements, and property-use regulations.
Review site surveys and project requirements to identify signage locations, potential issues, and information needed to prepare accurate client proposals.

Artwork, Quoting & Approvals

Request signage artwork from the FASTSIGNS National Accounts Art Department, ensuring customer brand standards and logo guidelines are met.
Review completed artwork for accuracy and coordinate revisions as needed.
Submit artwork for manufacturer, permitting, and installation quotes; follow up on outstanding estimates within established timeframes.
Compile estimates and prepare client quotes using established account margins; obtain approval when required.
Submit artwork to landlords for approval and coordinate revisions based on landlord feedback.

Project Execution & Closeout

Create purchase orders for permitting, manufacturing, and installation, and follow up to ensure work remains on schedule.
Maintain accurate project statuses, notes, contact details, and supporting documents in the project management system.
Competitively bid projects as needed to support the best value for clients.
Ensure completed jobs are accurately marked in the system so the Accounting Department can invoice clients.
Follow up weekly on active jobs and sales quotes to support timely completion.

Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Assist National Accounts team members with project follow-up and other projects as needed.
Help develop and improve project-management tools, catalog selections, processes, and procedures.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

Work Environment

This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment, including computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, shredders, and fax machines.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to talk and hear.

Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, non-exempt hourly position requiring at least 40 hours per week. Regular workdays are Monday through Friday, between 7:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required based on business needs.

Travel

This position requires minimal to no travel. Any travel would primarily be local during business days, although occasional out-of-area or overnight travel may be required based on job responsibilities.

Required Education And Experience

High school diploma or GED required.
Project coordination and/or sign-industry experience preferred.

Required Skills

Strong project-management, organization, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
General sign-industry knowledge.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work well under pressure, manage multiple priorities, and exercise sound business judgment.
Strong ethical conduct and customer-service mindset.

Required Core Competencies

Project Management
General Sign Knowledge
Organization
Problem Solving
Time Management
Written and Verbal Communication
Business Acumen
Ethical Conduct

We believe that everyone is capable of great things. Because of this, we encourage you to apply even if you do not have 100% of the qualifications listed above.

Propelled Brands values diversity and inclusion because it brings richness and strength to our business. We envision diversity as encompassing an individual’s unique characteristics and experiences, including not only race, gender, ethnicity, age, religion, disability, national origin, and sexual orientation, but also personality, gender expression, military status, mental health, educational and career backgrounds, and other life experiences. We know that supporting and building diversity is the right thing to do for our employees, our franchisees, our franchisees’ teams, and our stakeholders.

Job Description

Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers. Implements and oversees quality control processes to ensure all construction activities meet design specifications and industry standards. Conducts detailed site walks and leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects. Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps. Serves as the primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers. Selects, negotiates, and manages contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance and construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications. Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Construction Project Management-Project Planning and Execution:

Leads the construction of data centers by colocation providers, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
Develops and maintains detailed project schedules, coordinating with colocation providers to ensure timely milestone delivery across multiple projects.
Creates and manages project budgets, optimizing resource allocation to ensure cost-effective project execution.
Creates, reviews, and maintains documentation, including design review, commissioning, and problem-solving papers, ensuring standards are upheld, documents are managed effectively, and materials are suitable for their intended purpose.

Leads the startup and commissioning phases of major data center projects, ensuring that all systems are operational and meet design specifications.

Risk and Problem Management:

Evaluates the risk profiles associated with timely project delivery for multiple projects.
Identifies gaps in risk identification and mitigation and develops tailored solutions to address these gaps.

Stakeholder and Vendor Management:

Serves as the primary point of contact between the company and colocation providers, facilitating clear and effective communication, and resolving routine issues independently.
Develops and maintains key relationships to effectively support internal and external stakeholders, identifying opportunities for process improvements.
Selects, negotiates, and manages contracts with external vendors, contractors, and suppliers, ensuring contract compliance and performance.

Design Coordination and Improvement:

Collaborates with design teams to ensure that construction activities align with the approved design plans and specifications, addressing routine design issues independently.
Provides comprehensive colocation provider evaluation input for continuous improvement and identifies opportunities for process enhancements.
Oversees the installation of power, cooling, networking, and structured cabling systems, ensuring adherence to quality standards.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.

Continuous Learning:

Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.

Continuous Improvement:

Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

jobs.title: Interim Project Manager – D365 F&O      .
jobs.description:
Interim Project Manager – D365 F&O

Groenlo, Netherlands

32 - 38 hrs

€ 110 - € 130

Hybrid

What are you going to do?

“Bring direction and momentum to an ERP transformation that prepares Nedap for its next stage of growth.”

Nedap is bringing supply chain and finance processes across its market groups together on one future-proof ERP platform. By phasing out legacy systems, we create clearer processes, more reliable data, and a stronger foundation for scale and future AI-enabled capabilities.

The direction and roadmap are in place. As our Interim ERP Project Manager, you bring structure, seniority, and momentum to a complex change program in which process, data, technology, and multiple stakeholders come together. You are a senior sparring partner for experienced professionals and leadership: you help the team stay focused on the outcomes that matter, ensure that dependencies, risks, and unresolved choices receive the attention they need, and lead decision-making and escalation towards the Steering Committee.

You do not need to redefine the content direction: we are replacing Navision with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and aim to stay as close to the standard as possible. Within those boundaries, you are expected to critically test the existing roadmap and assumptions and, where needed, propose an alternative course. You turn priorities into practical next steps, make progress visible, and manage for results.

Start your application

Your responsibilities

Translate the existing roadmap into a clear delivery rhythm, with practical priorities, milestones, and follow-up - while identifying when assumptions, sequencing, or planning need to be adjusted.

Ensure open choices and bottlenecks reach the right people, push through when needed, and lead these topics effectively towards the Steering Committee.

Make progress, dependencies, risks, bottlenecks, and trade-offs visible, and steer towards the agreed result.

Align Finance, Operations, key users, IT, Microsoft, integration partners, and external logistics and warehousing parties around shared progress.

Work with business owners to identify optimization opportunities and ensure that process choices and customization deliver customer value within the F&O standard.

Your team

You will work within Nedap's IT General environment, alongside experienced ERP professionals and colleagues from across the organization. The team has the ERP expertise it needs; your contribution is senior project leadership: creating clarity, focus, and follow-through, connecting people, and leading the team through a critical delivery phase with a human approach.

You will work closely with business owners, leadership, key users, Microsoft, integration partners, and external parties connected to Nedap's processes and systems. The CFO is the sponsor; the Steering Committee consists of the CEO, CFO, IT Manager, and ERP implementation partner. You have mandate for day-to-day delivery, team leadership, and organizing execution. Changes in course, planning and budget, and decisions on process changes or customization investments are brought to the Steering Committee. You have the freedom to shape your approach and are expected to escalate and push through when progress requires it: four days per week, with at least three days at our Campus in Groenlo.

Our offer

What's in it for you?

This is an opportunity to lead a complex ERP transformation through its next phase and bring the direction already set through to a successful go-live. Success means more than putting Nedap NV fully operational on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: processes transition smoothly, adoption is secured, and the project team reaches the finish line together with a strong, positive way of working.

An assignment expected to run for at least 9 months, and to continue as needed to complete this delivery phase successfully.
A commitment of four days per week throughout the assignment.
An hourly rate in line with the level of responsibility. We would like you to share your all-in rate (excluding VAT) with us when sending in your application.
A complex, international program in which your contribution is visible in progress, decision quality, organizational adoption, and the way the project team works together.
We work based on trust, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and space. You bring expertise, an independent perspective, and human leadership. You stand behind your team, take and give space when needed, celebrate successes, and make sure the organization is well guided through choices, pace, and change.

All terms of employment

Required Skills

You enjoy bringing order and momentum to complex programs and act as a senior sparring partner for business and IT. You understand the connection between business processes, data, and technology, without needing to be the technical or functional specialist yourself. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and know how to help people move from discussion to decision and execution. You manage for results, while also managing the pace the team and organization can sustain.

Your experience includes:

Over 10 years of experience leading complex ERP implementations or transitions, preferably involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), in a role where you also led senior stakeholders and decision-making.
Bringing an existing ERP roadmap or implementation program through a critical delivery phase, including identifying risks and proposing well-founded course changes when needed.
Structuring planning, dependencies, risks, issues, and decision-making across multiple workstreams, with clear escalation to governance when decisions fall outside your mandate.
Managing stakeholders in a complex environment involving business teams, IT, implementation partners, and external integration parties.
Enough technical and architectural understanding to recognize risks and unnecessary customization, challenge constructively, and work with ERP specialists and partners to protect customer value within the F&O standard.

Good to know: this is an independent contractor assignment for four days per week, starting as soon as possible. The assignment is expected to run for at least nine months and to continue until Nedap NV is successfully live and fully operational on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. You will be present at our Campus in Groenlo at least three days per week.

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.

Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a

Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)

Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin

You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.

Your responsibilities include

Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications.
Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.
Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics.
Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe.
Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
Actively contributing to internal discussions.
Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication.
As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.

We are looking for

A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar
As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies.
Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus.
Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus.
Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
Willingness to travel outside Europe.

We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.

What we offer

An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.

Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement.

A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years.

About The Team

OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.

About The Role

As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths.

You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment.

This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY.

In This Role, You Will

Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross-functional partners.
Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk-management evidence, and incident reporting.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go-to-Market to align program priorities and deliverables.
Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting.
Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality.
Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have 6+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience.
Have experience working with an in-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in-house technology experience are strongly preferred.
Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel.
Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams.
Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity.
Are resourceful and hands-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technical concepts and navigate fast-moving technical environments.
Bring familiarity with content moderation, online safety, frontier AI governance, data governance, privacy, or emerging technology law as a plus. Depth in either content moderation or frontier AI governance is valuable; expertise in both is not required.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

Within OCI Networking Data Plane, the Fleet Management and Workload Orchestration team builds the common platform used to deploy, operate, and scale OCI Networking services worldwide. We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own delivery of strategic platform initiatives. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a technically credible, self-directed leader who turns ambiguous objectives into clear strategies and executable plans. You will work across engineering, architecture, operations, capacity, and infrastructure organizations to deliver reliable, scalable capabilities that improve how OCI Networking services are built and operated.

The opportunity

QBE Europe is recruiting for an experienced Program Manager to lead a significant multi-year Claims Transformation Programme.

This role will be responsible for the delivery of the Claims Cloud Transformation Programme, a multi-year initiative that will migrate our UK and European Claims operations onto a new Cloud platform. The programme will modernise our claims ecosystem, simplify technology landscapes, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer outcomes and establish the foundation for future cloud-enabled claims capabilities.

Reporting to the Head of Change Delivery, Claims & Operations, the successful candidate will be accountable for establishing, maintaining and driving delivery of the end-to-end programme roadmap across a 5+ year delivery horizon. The role will lead multiple workstream leads, delivery partners, technology suppliers and business stakeholders to achieve agreed business outcomes while ensuring alignment with enterprise, regional and global strategic objectives.

This is a highly visible leadership role requiring exceptional programme management, communication and stakeholder engagement skills. The successful candidate will create clarity and alignment across a complex delivery landscape by developing compelling plans, executive-level communications, delivery reporting and options analyses that enable timely and effective decision-making. At QBE, we get to the heart of what matters for our customers. And we do it all with a human touch.   

We’re an international insurer with more than 13,000 people working across 26 countries – which means we’re big enough for your ambitions, yet small enough for you to make a real impact. It’s an exciting time. We’re building momentum towards our vision to become the most consistent and innovative risk partner.

Support the transition to sustainable operational support models and cloud-based ways of working.

Overview

This is a hybrid role based out of Malvern, PA (3 days in office)

CubeSmart is seeking a Technical Program Manager — Data & Analytics to serve as the owner of our IT data and analytics intake process. This is a hybrid role based in Malvern, PA.

This role sits within the IT PMO and owns the end-to-end lifecycle of data and analytics project requests — from initial intake through prioritization, project planning, execution, and delivery. You will be the primary interface between business stakeholders and the technical data team (Business Intelligence, Qlik, and Data Engineering), ensuring that requests are well-defined, properly scoped, consistently prioritized, and tracked to completion in Asana.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience leading data and analytics projects, working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks and Qlik), strong stakeholder management skills, and the discipline to build and maintain a structured intake process in an organization actively maturing its PMO practices. You are comfortable in ambiguity, energized by building process from scratch, and skilled at bridging the gap between business problems and technical solutions. You are AI-ready — able to recognize where machine learning, generative AI, and predictive analytics create value, and comfortable leading projects that include AI/ML components. You are also AI-enabled: you actively leverage AI tools in your own work to move faster, communicate more clearly, and deliver more consistent program outcomes.

This is a greenfield opportunity. You're building the process from the beginning, with IT PMO leadership and executive sponsorship behind you. If you thrive in environments where relationships matter as much as methodology and where your work has visible impact on how the organization makes decisions — and if you are excited about building a data program management practice that is ready for an AI-driven future — this is the role for you.

Who We Are

At CubeSmart, we’re intentional about culture. You can experience it everywhere from our mission statement of “genuine care” to our “It’s What’s Inside That Counts” tagline to calling each other “teammates” rather than employees. This spirit fosters a fun and collaborative environment that has resulted in our rapid growth and being recognized amongst the top in our industry.

CubeSmart’s award-winning team is made up of people who genuinely care. Teammates care about our customers and the life events and/or business needs they are facing. Teammates are passionate, responsible and understanding. The CubeSmart team is made up of people who have a can-do attitude, are committed to their own success and the success of the company, and lead by example.

If this sounds like a team and culture that matches your personal values and motivations, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Intake & Prioritization

Own the Data Requests intake queue in Asana — the single front door for all data, analytics, reporting, and BI project requests across the organization.
Partner with business stakeholders to translate requests into well-defined project briefs, ensuring scope, business value, and success criteria are captured before work begins.
Facilitate and lead bi-weekly intake triage sessions with the data team; apply the PMO's Tier-based prioritization framework to recommend sequencing.
Maintain the integrity and hygiene of the Asana intake pipeline — statuses, stages, due dates, and ownership fields current at all times.
Serve as the communication bridge between requestors and the data team: set expectations, provide status updates, and surface blockers early.

Project Planning & Execution

jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

The role is part of the In-Space Systems business unit, which is focused on addressing two of the most compelling challenges in spaceflight today: space infrastructure and increasing mobility on-orbit.

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

This role is part of the Business Operations and Efficiency organization, which supports our Blue National Security business unit. Our mission is to maximize operational productivity and enable data-driven decision-making across Blue Origin through intelligent automation, analytics infrastructure, and operational excellence that allows teams to accomplish more with existing resources.

As part of a hardworking team of diverse specialists and analysts, you will work as a Senior Project Manager, Secure Facility Expansion responsible for leading the end-to-end planning, design, construction, and accreditation of multiple classified facilities across the country. You will serve as the primary project management lead for a significant multi-site secure facility expansion program, coordinating across internal stakeholders, external construction managers, architects, and government accrediting officials to deliver compliant, on-schedule, and cost-effective facilities. This is a high-visibility program with direct executive sponsorship and meaningful impact on Blue Origin's ability to pursue and execute national security missions.

We are seeking an individual with excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder leadership skills who can thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site construction environment. You will share in the team's impact on national security mission enablement, facilities excellence, and Blue Origin's long-term classified infrastructure strategy. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management for a multi-site secure facility construction program, including planning, design, construction execution, and government accreditation across multiple simultaneous locations
Manage and report on a Master Schedule spanning all active construction sites, tracking parallel milestones and critical path items across each location
Own program cost management and budget tracking, including cost estimate maintenance, change order management, contractor invoice review, and cost-to-complete forecasting
Serve as the primary owner's representative in weekly OAC (Owner-Architect-Contractor) meetings at each site, coordinating between Blue Origin internal teams, general contractors, architects, and specialty subcontractors
Coordinate the government accreditation process in close partnership with Security and IT teams, including Construction Security Plan submittals and sponsoring agency coordination
Identify, track, and resolve program risks, issues, and dependencies across all sites; escalate appropriately to executive stakeholders
Develop and maintain program status reports and executive briefings for senior leadership

Qualifications

BA/BS in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or related discipline
5+ years of project management experience in facilities construction, including direct responsibility for construction schedules, budgets, and contractor management
Demonstrated experience managing multi-site or multi-phase construction programs simultaneously
Strong proficiency in cost management and budget tracking for construction projects, including change order management and cost forecasting
Experience leading Owner-Architect-Contractor (OAC) or similar construction coordination meetings
Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder environments including internal leadership, external contractors, and government or regulatory bodies
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear executive-level status reports and briefings
Travel up to 50% required to support active construction sites across multiple U.S. locations
Must be a U.S. citizen
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret / SCI security clearance

Desired

Experience project managing ICD-705 compliant SCIF or SAPF construction, including familiarity with Construction Security Plans (CSPs) and government Accrediting Official (AO) coordination
Familiarity with TEMPEST, acoustic (STC), and physical security requirements for classified facilities
Active Top Secret / SCI security clearance
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent
Experience in aerospace, defense, or national security industry environments
Familiarity with ICD-705 or related Intelligence Community Directives governing secure facility construction

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25 CO applicants is $123,611.00 - $173,054.70 WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.

Grow with us as we innovate the next generation capabilities for a new era of space exploration! We offer a highly competitive benefits package along with a commitment to our core values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact, Inclusion and Excellence.

Redwire determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data, for our locations throughout the US. We will evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index, in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company.

As mandated by Executive Order 14042, all newly hired employees must be fully vaccinated before their start date unless a medical or religious accommodation is formally approved by Redwire prior to employment.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Networking provides the foundation for customers to run mission-critical workloads at global cloud scale.

Within OCI Networking Data Plane, the Fleet Management and Workload Orchestration team builds the common platform used to deploy, operate, and scale OCI Networking services worldwide. The platform provides fleet lifecycle management, workload placement, deployment automation, capacity expansion, and infrastructure orchestration.

We are seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own delivery of strategic platform initiatives. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a technically credible, self-directed leader who turns ambiguous objectives into clear strategies and executable plans. You will work across engineering, architecture, operations, capacity, and infrastructure organizations to deliver reliable, scalable capabilities that improve how OCI Networking services are built and operated.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the strategy, planning, and execution of complex, multi-quarter technical programs for the Fleet Management and Workload Orchestration platform.
Translate organizational priorities into well-defined program scope, outcomes, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and success measures.
Develop an informed point of view on technical and operational tradeoffs; recommend a path forward based on reliability, scalability, delivery risk, customer impact, and long-term platform value.
Partner with engineering and architecture leaders to align platform roadmaps with service needs and OCI-wide infrastructure priorities.
Drive delivery across teams responsible for networking services, distributed systems, capacity, deployment, observability, operations, and infrastructure.

Use operational learnings and delivery outcomes to improve platform capabilities, execution practices, and the organization’s ability to scale.
Build trusted relationships across OCI and influence outcomes without direct authority.

8+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, product operations, or a related role supporting cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or platform services.

jobs.title: Lead Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Partners with senior management and stakeholders to align priorities and goals using technical know-how in a fundamental engineering area or technical domain. Establishes scope and milestones for each aspect of a technical program, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services. Shapes and leads technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational initiatives impacting products and business. Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues. Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across multiple teams. Shapes technical collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals. Provides expert technical guidance to shape and direct the automation of comprehensive reporting, leading collaboration with development teams to drive innovations in reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for long-term technical program execution. Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams for high-impact technical programs.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Management:

– Leverages technical knowledge to identify risks, manage scope, estimate program timelines, request feasibility, testing requirements, and determine appropriate resources.

– Designs and shapes the strategy for product or service delivery, ensuring alignment with the third party, security, export, and accessibility compliance requirements.

– Integrates program demands and resourcing.

– Leads rapid response to the most critical security escalations, coordinating across teams and departments and serving as the primary point of contact to executives to assess risk, determine comprehensive mitigation strategies, and ensure alignment and execution of the most effective path to resolution.

– Leads the transformation and optimization of processes to ensure the highest reliability and resilience of products or services.

Technical Management and Execution - Technical Strategy and Execution:

– Utilizes technical knowledge to identify and manage program dependencies and risks.

– Supports rapid response to escalations, coordinating within team and communicating to senior team members to assess risk, determine mitigation strategies, and execute the optimal proposed path to resolution.

– Shapes overall planning activities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture.

– Defines and enforces delivery standards and guidelines, ensuring security, scalability, and alignment with best practices.

– Develops Line of Business (LOB) strategies for change management and/or incident response to enhance operational efficiency.

Program Oversight - Strategy and Decision-Making:

– Leads the alignment of priorities with customers, service, and stakeholder teams through regular reporting to stakeholders and senior leadership.

– Establishes scope and milestones, aligning to the broader program plan and company strategies and goals, managing efforts between cross-functional teams to deliver programs or services.

– Leads efforts to define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and measurement methods for LOB performance.

– Develops and communicates a comprehensive and strategic communication strategy of highly complex objectives to partners and customers.

Program Oversight - Program and Operations Management:

– Shapes and leads both technical and non-technical programs and highly complex, cross-organizational programs impacting products and business.

– Guides and mentors program staff (e.g., development, release management, customer success), providing expert technical support and strategic direction on removing barriers, including risks and issues in workflows.

– Provides guidance on developing and maintaining comprehensive program documentation (e.g., status reports, program plans) and develops risk mitigation strategies.

– Ensures attention to detail, including security and quality, in program management, from planning to execution and reporting.

– Chairs regular program status meetings, fostering collaboration and driving effective communication across teams and leaders.

– Partners with leadership to set service level agreements (SLAs) and productivity benchmarks aligned with long-term business goals.

– Shapes and leads forecasting program demands, funding, and resourcing.

– Leads the deployment of change management for programs, such as priority, scope, scheduling, development, requirement changes, and support.

Program Oversight - Risk Management:

– Drives the management of and responses to issues, bottlenecks, and risks, serving as a point of escalation for all issues.

– Develops plans based on the results of cost assessments, benefits analysis, and return on investment (ROI) to improve decision-making and risk mitigation strategies.

– Makes strategic decisions, balancing business needs, technical constraints, and long-term goals.

– Removes critical blockers for the program and determines optimal technical and resource options to drive the successful delivery and adoption of solutions.

Process Efficiency - Process Optimization:

– Shapes program improvement strategies, leveraging best practices to drive transformational change and optimize processes across the LOB.

– Leads the development and optimization of program objectives and workflows, while orchestrating the deployment of cross-functional solutions to address complex business problems.

– Collaborates with management to innovate and optimize processes and procedures to drive achievement of LOB goals.

Process Efficiency - Continuous Improvement:

– Champions LOB-wide integration of continuous improvement within programs, ensuring alignment of insights across many workstreams with business objectives and operational efficiency goals.

– Establishes and champions best practices for leveraging data insights at scale, influencing senior leadership decisions.

– Leads the development of innovative business-critical improvements to the solution's availability and reliability.

– Iterates processes based on feedback and KPIs, analyzing results through retrospectives.

– Defines requirements and configurations of existing and new development tools, where applicable.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Cross Functional Collaboration:

– Shapes collaboration across multiple teams, ensuring alignment of priorities and program goals.

– Leads process improvements across the LOB, working with senior leaders to implement team-wide efficiency-driven solutions.

– Communicates strategic program updates and insights to leadership teams, shaping decisions at the LOB level.

– Develops and refines engagement approaches for key stakeholders, ensuring informed decision-making at scale to improve program planning and execution.

Collaboration and Program Leadership - Program Leadership:

– Shapes and leads programs to optimize organizational efficiency.

– Provides visionary technical direction and mentorship to cross-functional teams.

– Drives transformative change at all levels of the LOB, from initiation through delivery, while ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

– Ensures that the program team and other stakeholders are aligned with the program goals and motivated, identifying and addressing conflicts and issues.

Data and Analysis:

– Shapes and directs the automation of comprehensive reporting, collaborating with development teams to drive continuous improvement of reports, dashboards, forecasts, and models for program execution.

– Utilizes data insights to solve highly complex problems impacting the success of the program(s), including adherence to SLAs.

– Conducts analysis on a large number of data sources with high complexity, which may include competitive analysis, trend analysis, and KPI analysis, to drive data-informed decisions to support the program goals, presenting findings with immediate teams stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

– Shapes the strategic direction of collaboration efforts across stakeholder teams for high-impact programs.

– Serves as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment between program priorities and business objectives.

– Defines strategies for enhancing customer engagement, aligning service offerings with evolving business needs.

– Drives large-scale product and process enhancements, influencing and guiding the LOB.

– Develops and presents advanced strategies to mitigate risks to customer satisfaction, assessing the impact of mitigation efforts on broader group objectives.

– Leads the alignment of varied priorities and Oracle commitments, ensuring optimal coverage and response to customer needs, minimizing organizational risk to programs.

Planning & Execution:

Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Problem Solving:

Continuous Learning:

Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

jobs.description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as a Data Security Program Manager. Positioned to be the best in class of program execution across Technology at Morgan Stanley, the Strategic Programs Execution (SPE) is a Super Department in Cyber, Data, Risk and Resilience (CDRR). This function facilitates enhanced delivery capability to effectively manage the increasing pipeline of critical technology, regulatory, risk and control-based programs.

Job Summary

Responsible for leading complex data security programs that reduce firmwide risk, strengthen control execution, and advance the Firm's Data Security Strategy. This individual will manage cross-divisional delivery across Technology, Cyber, Business, Risk, and Control stakeholders, with accountability for planning, governance, milestone execution, risk and issue management, metrics reporting, and executive communication. The candidate should bring strong program management discipline, data security domain awareness, and the ability to translate technical control delivery into risk-reducing outcomes for senior leadership.

Initial Assignment

As Data Security Program Manager, responsible for driving execution of data security risk reduction initiatives across the Data Security Risk Execution (DSRE) portfolio, supporting governance through the Data Security Execution Governance Committee (DSEGC), and ensuring delivery aligns to the Firm's Data Security Strategy, applicable policy requirements, and risk appetite.

The program scope includes oversight of data security capabilities including Data Leakage Prevention, Data Discovery, Data Masking, Secure Logging, Encryption at Rest, Encryption in Transit, Post-Quantum Cryptography readiness, API security, identity and access management, anomalous behavior detection, incident management, external website controls, network security, vendor risk management, and third-party data protection.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring close partnership with control owners, delivery leads, Business Unit sponsors, 1LOD/2LOD/3LOD stakeholders, and senior governance forums to drive transparent execution, timely escalation, and sustainable transition of mature capabilities to business-as-usual monitoring. The program is currently in its execution phase but detailed approach and plan for BAU transition yet to be agreed.

Responsibilities

Lead data security risk reduction execution: coordinate delivery across DSRE workstreams, ensuring milestones, action plans, dependencies, and risk-reducing outcomes are clearly defined, tracked, and achieved.

Manage governance and executive reporting: prepare high-quality updates for DSEGC and related governance forums, including program status, risks, issues, decisions, metrics, and path-to-green plans.

Drive milestone-based delivery plans and BAU transition: establish integrated plans that support control implementation, adoption, operational readiness, evidence capture, and sustainable metrics-based monitoring.

Manage cross-program dependencies: partner with related technology, cyber, risk, policy, and business programs to align scope, delivery sequencing, control requirements

Strengthen data security metrics and risk reporting: partner with metrics owners to define KPIs, KRIs, thresholds, trends, and executive narratives that demonstrate measurable control effectiveness and risk reduction.

Support emerging technology and AI security integration: identify opportunities to improve data protection governance for AI-enabled use cases, external websites, APIs, SaaS platforms, and other evolving data movement channels.

Develop program artifacts: maintain charters, roadmaps, stakeholder maps, RAID logs, action trackers, decision logs, program briefs, meeting materials, and executive-level communications.

Translate data into actionable insights for senior audiences: analyze program status, delivery trends, control metrics, risks, dependencies

Requirements

At least 10 years demonstrable project management experience
Demonstrable track record of operating and delivering at program manager level - 3 years minimum
Demonstrable experience leading change in a data security, cyber risk, technology controls, compliance, or regulatory environment.
Experience producing executive-ready program reporting, including milestone plans, RAID logs, KPI/KRI dashboards, OpenPages Issue and Action Plan status, and governance materials for senior committees.
Experienced of leading projects/programs using waterfall and agile methodologies

Skills

Strong knowledge of data security, cyber controls, risk management, and technology governance, with familiarity across DLP, data discovery, encryption, identity and access management, incident response, API security, vendor risk, and third-party data protection.
Previous experience on data security, cyber risk, control remediation, regulatory, or assessment programs strongly preferred.
Leading and driving delivery teams
Transitioning into BAU, including change management
Managing using a risk-based data security program approach, including alignment of milestones, evidence, metrics, issues, and action plans to measurable risk reduction.
Defining and tracking data security benefits, including improved control coverage, reduced residual risk, stronger governance, increased transparency, and sustainable BAU monitoring.
Effective interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to create a sense of community amongst the disparate members of the project teams
A strong knowledge of techniques for planning, monitoring, and controlling programs

You act as the primary interface between engineering teams, operations, external partners (e.g., IP vendors, foundries, OSATs), management, and customers, driving alignment and clear communication at all levels.
You manage the end-to-end silicon development lifecycle, including program milestones such as architecture definition, design, verification, tape-out, silicon bring-up, validation, qualification, and product ramp-up.
You identify and manage technical dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across multiple disciplines, ensuring timely decision-making and effective mitigation strategies.
You drive execution transparency through structured program reviews, dashboards, and regular reporting of status, risks, dependencies, and key performance indicators.
You ensure readiness across all program phases, including design sign-off, validation strategy, and manufacturing preparedness, while continuously improving development processes and methodologies.
When requirements or priorities change, you assess impacts at the program level and steer cross-functional teams through transitions while maintaining schedule and quality commitments.

Job Requirements

A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.
3+ years of experience in semiconductors, ASIC/SoC, or embedded systems development.
Strong understanding of chip development flows, including architecture, RTL design, verification, physical implementation, tape-out, and silicon validation.
Solid program management expertise (planning, risk management, dependency tracking, stakeholder communication) and familiarity with industry-standard methodologies (e.g., PMI, IPMA).
Automotive experience (e.g., ISO 26262, ASPICE) is a plus.
A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset with strong leadership and organizational skills.
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to translate complex technical topics into clear messages for both technical and executive stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Description

ICF's Disaster Management Division seeks a Senior Project Manager
to support clients in implementing federally- and state-funded residential mitigation grant projects.  This position is hybrid with on-site work in Los Angeles County, CA.
The Senior Project Manager will be focused on leading residential property mitigation projects to reduce the risk to homes and property from natural hazards including wildfires, wind, ice storms, and severe weather.

The ideal candidate will be a proven Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Hazard Mitigation Assistance (HMA) Project Manager
with a track record of superior execution and growth and will be responsible for ensuring that programs are positioned to optimize disaster grant resource allocation, build strong solutions to impacted areas, and provide strong risk management. This position represents an exceptional opportunity to join an expert team to facilitate change and help make a lasting difference.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the development, coordination, and operation of various large, complex federally funded programs, focused on residential mitigation and community resilience, from start up through closeout.
Serve as an expert in FEMA HMA grant programs and advise local government and private non-profit clients on large-scale mitigation projects.
Manage delivery of project tasks, activities, milestones and resources, developing, maintaining, and managing project requirements, plans, timeline, issues, risks and challenges
Direct risk and vulnerability assessments and develop strategies to reduce risk, such as building code updates, retrofitting structures, and community-wide preparedness plans.
Coordinate clients’ resilience priorities, secure grant funding, and successfully implement federally and state-funded programs in compliance with all applicable program policies, requirements, procedures, guidelines.
Oversee on-going public education and outreach programs, including clearly explaining complex technical concepts to various audiences, including homeowners and community members.
Lead stakeholder engagement and coordination with local, state, and federal agency representatives, community-based organizations, industry, and non-profits to achieve common mitigation goals.
Manage a team of professionals including engineers, grant managers, contractors, and emergency managers to implement mitigation projects.
Monitor program performance status and establish necessary quality control tools to manage and measure programs results.
Serve as the key project interface with ICF leadership, delivering updates on milestones/challenges, and using data-driven reporting and analysis to inform decisions.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree
8+ years of experience and demonstrated success managing complex multi-disciplinary teams to achieve high levels of production, meet tight deadlines, and deliver compliant, quality work products.
5+ years of FEMA HMA project experience including program start-up through implementation and closeout
Willingness to work in and travel across California as necessary

Master’s or higher-level degree in a related field.
Experience securing federal grants of $50 million or greater.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
