jobs.title: Project Manager, Preventive Maintenance - Dyersburg
jobs.description:
Amteck is a Top 50 electrical contractor, and we are looking to add a Project Manager - Preventive Maintenance to our Dyersburg team!

Primary Role

The Preventive Maintenance Project Manager (PMPM) is ultimately responsible for the successful planning, execution, quality, customer satisfaction, and financial performance of assigned electrical preventive maintenance programs and related service projects. This position leads all aspects of recurring maintenance agreements, site audits, arc flash studies, infrared inspections, testing services, corrective maintenance recommendations, outage coordination, and customer success activities.

The PMPM serves as the primary point of contact between the customer and Amteck and is responsible for developing long-term partnerships that improve electrical reliability, safety, compliance, and operational performance. This position requires strong business management skills, leadership ability, technical knowledge of electrical systems, excellent communication skills, and a thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, NETA standards, OEM maintenance requirements, and industrial maintenance practices.

This position reports to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success and works closely with Operations, Service, Engineering, Business Development, Safety, and Executive Leadership teams.

Responsibilities

Manage all aspects of assigned preventive maintenance programs, service agreements, and maintenance-related projects from initiation through completion.
Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts and maintain regular communication regarding project status, findings, recommendations, and future opportunities.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships that result in long-term partnerships and recurring maintenance agreements.
Coordinate annual maintenance schedules with customers to ensure inspections, testing, outages, shutdowns, and maintenance events are completed on time.
Lead project planning activities, including scope development, manpower planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, reporting, and resource allocation.
Review customer facilities, electrical infrastructure, and operational requirements to develop maintenance strategies that improve equipment reliability and reduce risk.
Coordinate and facilitate site audits, asset inventories, equipment criticality assessments, and risk evaluations.
Work closely with Business Development personnel to transition opportunities into successful project execution.
Manage project costs, labor utilization, material expenditures, subcontractors, and financial performance to achieve departmental objectives.
Create and maintain project schedules while coordinating resources across multiple customer locations.
Review preventive maintenance reports and inspection findings for technical accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, NETA standards, OEM recommendations, and customer-specific safety requirements.
Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, customer presentations, closeout meetings, and internal project reviews.
Coordinate outage planning and shutdown activities with customers and field leadership.
Work directly with Lead Technicians and Maintenance Technicians to establish project expectations, priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
Mentor and develop Maintenance Leads, Technicians, and Project Coordinators.
Assist with workforce planning and manpower forecasting for maintenance programs and service agreements.
Review and approve maintenance scopes, quotes, corrective action plans, and recommendations before submission to customers.
Identify opportunities for additional maintenance services, corrective repairs, system upgrades, engineering studies, and reliability improvements.
Support development and implementation of department standards, processes, templates, reporting tools, and best practices.
Review and analyze maintenance data, equipment condition information, testing results, and asset health indicators to identify trends and risks.
Assist customers with maintenance budgeting and capital planning efforts by identifying future maintenance and reliability needs.
Manage project documentation including maintenance reports, action item logs, schedules, customer correspondence, inspection records, and closeout documents.
Coordinate procurement of tools, testing equipment, rental equipment, materials, and subcontract services.
Review and resolve open purchase orders, project costs, invoices, and receivables.
Ensure maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Amteck quality standards.
Investigate customer concerns, project challenges, quality issues, and safety incidents while implementing corrective actions.
Provide leadership in promoting a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, professionalism, and customer success.
Communicate effectively with all internal departments and external stakeholders.

Position Requirements

Technical Expertise:

Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, industrial electrical equipment, motor control systems, switchgear, transformers, MCCs, panelboards, protective devices, and control systems.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B electrical maintenance requirements.
Strong knowledge of NFPA 70E, OSHA regulations, and electrical safety practices.
Knowledge of NETA testing procedures and electrical reliability principles.
Ability to interpret electrical one-line drawings, control schematics, equipment specifications, maintenance reports, and testing results.
Understanding of asset management, equipment criticality, risk assessment, reliability-centered maintenance, and predictive maintenance technologies.
Working knowledge of infrared thermography, power quality analysis, electrical testing, and condition-based maintenance practices.

Project Management Skills

Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.
Strong planning, scheduling, budgeting, and organizational skills.
Experience coordinating outages, shutdowns, maintenance events, and field personnel.
Ability to identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to establish priorities and delegate responsibilities effectively.

Customer Success & Communication

Exceptional customer relationship management skills.
Commitment to providing outstanding customer service and long-term value.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to confidently present maintenance findings and recommendations to maintenance personnel, engineering teams, plant leadership, and executive management.
Ability to communicate technical information in a clear and understandable manner.

Technology & Software

High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Experience with maintenance management software, project management systems, scheduling software, and mobile reporting tools.
Ability to analyze maintenance data and develop customer-facing reports.
Strong overall computer skills and ability to learn new software platforms quickly.

Safety & Compliance

Promote, enforce, and support all company safety policies and procedures.
Ensure all maintenance activities are conducted in accordance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, company policy, and customer requirements.
Demonstrate commitment to the belief that all incidents are preventable.
Foster a culture of safety excellence and continuous improvement.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success.
Works closely with Business Development Managers, Project Coordinators, Lead Technicians, Maintenance Technicians, Regional Operations Leadership, Engineering, Safety, and Executive Leadership.
Serves as the primary communication link between customers and the Preventive Maintenance Department.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 5-10 years of experience in industrial electrical maintenance, electrical service, reliability engineering, electrical testing, project management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing maintenance programs, service projects, or industrial operations.
Strong knowledge of electrical preventive maintenance principles and best practices.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, and applicable electrical codes.
Experience working within industrial manufacturing, processing, utility, or commercial facilities.
Ability to review and understand maintenance reports, testing data, and equipment condition assessments.
Strong financial awareness and understanding of project cost management.
Current valid driver's license.
Ability to travel as required to customer locations, approximately 50% maximum
Excellent organizational, leadership, and customer service skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment factors for this position will vary greatly based on customer facilities and project locations. Candidates must be comfortable working in manufacturing plants, processing facilities, utility environments, commercial facilities, and outdoor environments.

Travel may be required to support customer locations and project activities. Site visits may involve exposure to energized electrical equipment, industrial hazards, elevated work platforms, varying weather conditions, confined spaces, and extended walking throughout large facilities. Candidates must be capable of conducting facility assessments, participating in outage activities, attending customer meetings, and supporting field operations as necessary.

I
n 1977 Amteck was founded in Central Kentucky with the belief that growth only comes by listening and responding to both clients and employees. Four decades later, Amteck has grown from a small electrical contracting firm to a national leader in the design/build support electrical contracting industry. Amteck specializes in facility growth expansion initiatives of companies that operate in the manufacturing, industrial, process, food, and beverage, hospitality, healthcare, distribution facilities, and commercial and institutional sectors. The number one goal is the Safety of our Employees and maintaining our culture and core values: THE AMTECK WAY – SAFETY, QUALITY, & CUSTOMER SATISFACTION.

jobs.title: Legal Program Manager (Regulatory Compliance)
jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Legal team helps advance our mission by tackling novel legal issues in AI. Our team brings together professionals across technology, privacy, intellectual property, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. Our regulatory compliance work turns legal requirements into practical programs that support responsible AI development and deployment.

About The Role

As a Legal Program Manager focused on regulatory compliance, you will build and manage cross-functional programs that translate counsel’s guidance into practical, sustainable operations. Your initial focus may include content moderation and/or frontier AI governance, with the mix shaped by team priorities and your strengths.

You will partner with internal and external counsel, other legal program managers, and technical and business teams to coordinate implementation, evidence collection, reporting, and ongoing compliance. You’ll build repeatable systems that scale across regulations, products, and jurisdictions, helping teams navigate emerging requirements with clarity and sound judgment.

This full-time role is based in San Francisco, CA, or New York, NY.

In This Role, You Will

Lead regulatory compliance programs end to end: define scope, owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation paths, and drive execution with counsel and cross-functional partners.
Translate counsel’s regulatory guidance into repeatable workflows, controls, and documentation. Depending on your portfolio, this may include content moderation disclosures, transparency reporting, reporting and appeals workflows, or frontier AI model launch readiness, evaluation and risk-management evidence, and incident reporting.
Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, User Operations, Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), Global Affairs, Communications, and Go-to-Market to align program priorities and deliverables.
Support regulatory inquiries, audits and investigations with counsel, organizing evidence and responses to support timely, accurate communication and reporting.
Maintain a reliable source of truth for obligations, controls, decisions, evidence, and reporting. Demonstrate compliance readiness and control effectiveness, and improve program timeliness and evidence quality.
Identify execution risks and compliance gaps, track remediation, and escalate blockers. Establish clear success measures and operating cadences, keeping legal conclusions subject to counsel’s review.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You

Have 6+ years of experience in program management, regulatory compliance, or related fields in a tech-forward or highly regulated environment, including relevant legal, regulatory, or compliance program experience.
Have experience working with an in-house legal team; regulatory matters experience and in-house technology experience are strongly preferred.
Have demonstrated experience building and scaling compliance programs, translating legal or regulatory requirements into operational workflows, and maintaining reliable documentation and evidence in partnership with counsel.
Take ownership of complex projects, set and achieve milestones, synthesize cross-functional input, and build trust across legal, technical, and business teams.
Bring strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. Exercise sound judgment under pressure, adapt to changing priorities, and make progress through ambiguity.
Are resourceful and hands-on, with enthusiasm for AI technology and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar technical concepts and navigate fast-moving technical environments.
Bring familiarity with content moderation, online safety, frontier AI governance, data governance, privacy, or emerging technology law as a plus. Depth in either content moderation or frontier AI governance is valuable; expertise in both is not required.
Bring data analysis or SQL skills, or relevant professional qualifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CPA, or CISSP, as a plus.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

The role is part of the In-Space Systems business unit, which is focused on addressing two of the most compelling challenges in spaceflight today: space infrastructure and increasing mobility on-orbit.

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

This role is part of the Business Operations and Efficiency organization, which supports our Blue National Security business unit. Our mission is to maximize operational productivity and enable data-driven decision-making across Blue Origin through intelligent automation, analytics infrastructure, and operational excellence that allows teams to accomplish more with existing resources.

As part of a hardworking team of diverse specialists and analysts, you will work as a Senior Project Manager, Secure Facility Expansion responsible for leading the end-to-end planning, design, construction, and accreditation of multiple classified facilities across the country. You will serve as the primary project management lead for a significant multi-site secure facility expansion program, coordinating across internal stakeholders, external construction managers, architects, and government accrediting officials to deliver compliant, on-schedule, and cost-effective facilities. This is a high-visibility program with direct executive sponsorship and meaningful impact on Blue Origin's ability to pursue and execute national security missions.

We are seeking an individual with excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder leadership skills who can thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site construction environment. You will share in the team's impact on national security mission enablement, facilities excellence, and Blue Origin's long-term classified infrastructure strategy. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management for a multi-site secure facility construction program, including planning, design, construction execution, and government accreditation across multiple simultaneous locations
Manage and report on a Master Schedule spanning all active construction sites, tracking parallel milestones and critical path items across each location
Own program cost management and budget tracking, including cost estimate maintenance, change order management, contractor invoice review, and cost-to-complete forecasting
Serve as the primary owner's representative in weekly OAC (Owner-Architect-Contractor) meetings at each site, coordinating between Blue Origin internal teams, general contractors, architects, and specialty subcontractors
Coordinate the government accreditation process in close partnership with Security and IT teams, including Construction Security Plan submittals and sponsoring agency coordination

Ideal Candidate Profile:
Seeking a seasoned IT Project Manager wi th experience leading large-scale technology initiatives using Agile, SAFe, Waterfall, and Kanban methodologies. The ideal candidate has documented risk management experience and has successfully served as the PM of record for a Commonwealth Category 1 or 2 project valued at $5M+ or a non-Commonwealth project exceeding $10M. Strong experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, vendors, and executive stakeholder communications is required.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Candidate will lead and manage projects within the Project& Product Delivery team utilizing Agile, SAFe, Waterfall and Kanban methodologies. Ability to work closely with all stakeholders including the senior leadership, business, cross functional teams and vendors.

This position's specific responsibilities and duties will include, but are not limited to:

Drives consistent project delivery through the entire project lifecycle, including: project plans, release plans, resource allocation, and management of project risks, scope, schedule, and delivery of value.

Coordinates Agile Ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Retrospectives, Sprint Demos, Story Refinement, and Release Planning.

Tracks and communicates project's progress from a schedule, cost, and risk perspective to the project team, stakeholders, and management.

Establishes an environment where the teams can be effective and helps removing obstacles.

Protects the team from outside interruptions and distractions.

Ensures a good relationship between the team and product owner as well as others outside the team.

Tracks and reports team velocity and other project metrics.

Promotes continuous improvement and helps teams to increase productivity.

Helps Product Owner and team with Product backlog management.

Ensures the teams are practicing core Agile, Waterfall and VITA principles and processes.

Adheres to client VITA project management practices as defined.

Additional Responsibilities As Assigned.

Required Skills & Experience

Solid understanding of software development lifecycle models as well as expert knowledge of Agile project management principles and practices.

Ability to work with customers, understand their business practices and manage their expectations.

Ability to set clear performance standards and hold team members accountable, while keeping team engaged and on track.

Ability to help Product Owners to create and prioritize Product Backlog.

Strong interpersonal skills including mentoring, coaching, collaborating, and team building.

Strong analytical, organizational and decision-making skills.

Ability to analyze and document business and system processes.

Ability to balance the competing demands for quality, scope, schedule, and cost.

Well-versed with Scrum and Kanban Agile methodologies.

Experience with SAFe framework is a plus.

jobs.title: NPI Materials Program Manager 4
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Senior New Product Introduction Materials Program Manager to drive materials planning, manufacturing coordination, and supply execution supporting OCI’s global cloud infrastructure and data center deployment operations.

This role is responsible for ensuring material availability, manufacturing readiness, inventory optimization, and operational alignment across contract manufacturers, suppliers, and internal cross-functional teams. The NPI Materials Program Manager will work closely with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, and Data Center Operations to support OCI’s rapidly growing infrastructure footprint.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience in materials management, manufacturing operations, inventory planning, and supplier management within high-tech hardware, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale manufacturing environments.

Responsibilities

Materials Planning & Execution

Collaborate with Demand Planning and Supply Planning teams to align material availability with short-term and long-term forecast requirements.
Analyze forecast demand, supply risks, and material constraints to support execution and continuity of supply.
Partner with contract manufacturers to manage material readiness, lead times, and production schedules.
Ensure timely delivery of rack and infrastructure products to support OCI deployment requirements.
Validate clean-to-build (CTB) assessments to confirm material availability for planned production.
Identify material shortages and gaps at contract manufacturers and drive escalation and resolution activities.
Support inventory planning strategies that balance supply continuity, inventory optimization, and operational efficiency.
Help manage excess and obsolete inventory mitigation activities in partnership with planning and operations teams.

Contract Manufacturer & Supplier Management

Manage operational relationships with Contract Manufacturers (CMs), ODMs, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
Drive supplier and manufacturing commit alignment at weekly, monthly, and quarterly intervals.
Ensure manufacturing partners have sufficient materials and capacity to support demand plans.
Monitor inventory control practices and material management processes at contract manufacturer and warehouse locations.
Work with suppliers and manufacturers on stocking and buffering strategies to improve supply continuity and responsiveness.
Support KPI reviews and operational performance management with manufacturing partners.

Manufacturing & Operational Coordination

Partner with Manufacturing and Operations teams to ensure capacity planning supports forecasted demand.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities to ensure materials are qualified and production-ready .
Coordinate across Engineering, Product Operations, Commodity Management, and Deployment teams to support operational readiness.
Help drive process improvements that improve material flow, execution efficiency, and operational scalability.

Risk Management & Process Improvement

Identify supply chain risks, material shortages, and operational bottlenecks that may impact production or deployment schedules.
Support mitigation planning including alternate sourcing, supplier recovery actions, and inventory buffering strategies.
Track and report key operational metrics related to inventory health, supplier performance, material availability, and manufacturing execution.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory accuracy, planning efficiency, and supply chain execution.

Leadership & Collaboration

Lead materials program teams and mentor junior supply chain team members in a fast-paced operational environment.
Build strong working relationships across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Engineering, Procurement, and Deployment organizations.
Communicate operational risks, supply challenges, and mitigation plans to leadership teams.
Contribute to long-term supply chain planning and operational scaling initiatives supporting OCI growth.

Experience

Required Qualifications

6-10 years of experience in materials management, supply chain operations, manufacturing planning, or related functions.
Experience working with contract manufacturers, suppliers, and global manufacturing operations.
Strong background in inventory management, production scheduling, materials planning, and supply chain execution.
Experience supporting hardware manufacturing, cloud infrastructure, networking, server, or high-tech operations environments preferred.
Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) or manufacturing ramp activities preferred.

Technical & Functional Skills

Strong understanding of materials management, manufacturing operations, inventory control, and supply chain planning processes.
Experience with ERP, MRP, or supply chain management systems.
Analytical mindset with experience developing and managing operational KPIs and performance metrics.
Knowledge of manufacturing capacity planning, supplier management, and logistics operations.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Leadership & Communication

Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Effective communicator with the ability to drive alignment across cross-functional teams.
Proven ability to solve operational challenges using data-driven decision-making.
Experience leading teams and influencing without direct authority across global organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in cloud infrastructure, hyperscale, or data center operations environments.
Familiarity with manufacturing automation or supply chain process optimization.
Experience with Oracle ERP or Oracle Supply Chain applications preferred.

Why Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is helping organizations around the world run mission-critical workloads with industry-leading performance, reliability, and scalability. This role offers the opportunity to directly support the infrastructure supply chain powering OCI’s global expansion while working alongside world-class engineering and operations teams.

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

Salaried, Leadership Position with a Growing Company!

Starting Salary Starting at $55,000 / Year + Benefits & Performance-Based Bonus Opportunity

Previous Security Leadership Experience Is Required

Plenty of Room for Advancement!

Allied Universal® is hiring a Security Operations Manager
in Memphis, Tennessee
. The Operations Manager is a central leader in ensuring successful delivery of security services across assigned client sites. This role oversees frontline hiring, staffing, scheduling, training, and operational compliance while serving as a critical support and escalation point for employees and clients. The Operations Manager will champion high‑quality service, workforce stability, and operational consistency by proactively addressing performance concerns, maintaining contractual staffing levels, and building strong client relationships Why Join Allied Universal?

Responsibilities

Selection and Placement

Manage the selection and placement process for new security professionals, including first-line supervisors; design and implement career development and performance improvement plans; evaluate low-performing employees for replacement, upgrade or transfer
Make initial job offers (for new employees) and job transfers (for existing employees) using company forms and procedures, offering rates, schedules and benefits in alignment with post contract requirements; maintain and publish weekly Open Post List and actively manage job openings within division/branch

Schedule and Workforce Management

Create, modify and manage post schedules in WinTeam to ensure adequate coverage at all times; ensure schedules are properly maintained in WinTeam and are updated regularly
Ensure all positions are staffed according to contract requirements and effectively manage branch overtime through proper scheduling and staffing; maintain a qualified, sufficient pool of flex personnel for backfill of vacant positions as needed
Maintain regular proactive contact with Security Professionals to ensure all staff is being effectively utilized, properly trained, and ready for placement as needed. Review “No Hours Report” with branch Human Resource staff on a weekly basis, and disposition employees who are on “active” status with no hours, in accordance with company policies, ensuring no employees remain on “no hours” status beyond 3 weeks

Process requests for final paychecks, anniversary bonuses and other pay related issues, and execute the distribution of such pay; act as a Company representative in such matters as unemployment hearings, workers’ compensation hearings/depositions, union meetings (where applicable), state agency activities, depositions, and other related liability matters

Employee Relations

Conduct disciplinary and counseling sessions with Security Professionals as needed in a proactive and professional manner. Ensure all such issues are documented according to company standards, and that all issues receive proper follow up for resolution
Initiate termination procedures as needed for voluntary and involuntary separations; execute termination meetings as necessary and complete all follow up documentation according to company standards
Maintain high employee morale and low employee turnover through effective and proactive communications and timely problem resolution; ensure all hiring, counseling, disciplinary and termination procedures are executed in a consistent manner
Ensure a smooth running operation by enforcing post specific policies and procedures through proper communication and training; may utilize field training staff to assist in executing post-specific training

Qualifications (must Have)

High School diploma or equivalent
Current driver’s license if driving a company vehicle, or personal vehicle in the course of conducting business (e.g., client visits, attending networking events)
Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
Minimum of three (3) years of leadership experience in a high-volume workforce environment, preferably in the protective service industry
Work experience in successfully building and developing teams
Leadership skills that foster teamwork, innovation, agility, client relations and achieving desired results
Ability to maintain a profitable book of business by cross-collaborating and utilizing results-oriented problem-solving skills to meet both client and employee growth and satisfaction
Proficiency in web-based applications and computer systems, including Microsoft Office and (BI) Business Intelligence tools for metrics analysis, reporting, automation, and presentations
Dynamic networking skills displaying a commitment to safety and trust by participating in local community, client and industry events
Basic understanding of financial principles, including budgeting and financial reporting; ability to interpret simple financial data and use it to support decision-making

College degree in criminal justice, business administration, or a related field
Experience managing a dispersed workforce in a multi-location operation
Law enforcement, military and/or contract or proprietary security services, or facility management experience
American Society of Industrial Security (ASIS), International Certified Protection Professional (CPP) certification
Previous payroll, billing and scheduling experience
Aptitude with security systems; CCTV, Access Control, and badge administration
Graduate of certified public safety academy (e.g., Law Enforcement, Firefighter/Paramedic, Corrections Officer)

jobs.title: Project Manager, Preventive Maintenance - Dyersburg
jobs.description:
Amteck is a Top 50 electrical contractor, and we are looking to add a Project Manager - Preventive Maintenance to our Dyersburg team!

Primary Role

The Preventive Maintenance Project Manager (PMPM) is ultimately responsible for the successful planning, execution, quality, customer satisfaction, and financial performance of assigned electrical preventive maintenance programs and related service projects. This position leads all aspects of recurring maintenance agreements, site audits, arc flash studies, infrared inspections, testing services, corrective maintenance recommendations, outage coordination, and customer success activities.

The PMPM serves as the primary point of contact between the customer and Amteck and is responsible for developing long-term partnerships that improve electrical reliability, safety, compliance, and operational performance. This position requires strong business management skills, leadership ability, technical knowledge of electrical systems, excellent communication skills, and a thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, NETA standards, OEM maintenance requirements, and industrial maintenance practices.

This position reports to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success and works closely with Operations, Service, Engineering, Business Development, Safety, and Executive Leadership teams.

Responsibilities

Manage all aspects of assigned preventive maintenance programs, service agreements, and maintenance-related projects from initiation through completion.
Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts and maintain regular communication regarding project status, findings, recommendations, and future opportunities.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships that result in long-term partnerships and recurring maintenance agreements.
Coordinate annual maintenance schedules with customers to ensure inspections, testing, outages, shutdowns, and maintenance events are completed on time.
Lead project planning activities, including scope development, manpower planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, reporting, and resource allocation.
Review customer facilities, electrical infrastructure, and operational requirements to develop maintenance strategies that improve equipment reliability and reduce risk.
Coordinate and facilitate site audits, asset inventories, equipment criticality assessments, and risk evaluations.
Work closely with Business Development personnel to transition opportunities into successful project execution.
Manage project costs, labor utilization, material expenditures, subcontractors, and financial performance to achieve departmental objectives.
Create and maintain project schedules while coordinating resources across multiple customer locations.
Review preventive maintenance reports and inspection findings for technical accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, NETA standards, OEM recommendations, and customer-specific safety requirements.
Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, customer presentations, closeout meetings, and internal project reviews.
Coordinate outage planning and shutdown activities with customers and field leadership.
Work directly with Lead Technicians and Maintenance Technicians to establish project expectations, priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
Mentor and develop Maintenance Leads, Technicians, and Project Coordinators.
Assist with workforce planning and manpower forecasting for maintenance programs and service agreements.
Review and approve maintenance scopes, quotes, corrective action plans, and recommendations before submission to customers.
Identify opportunities for additional maintenance services, corrective repairs, system upgrades, engineering studies, and reliability improvements.
Support development and implementation of department standards, processes, templates, reporting tools, and best practices.
Review and analyze maintenance data, equipment condition information, testing results, and asset health indicators to identify trends and risks.
Assist customers with maintenance budgeting and capital planning efforts by identifying future maintenance and reliability needs.
Manage project documentation including maintenance reports, action item logs, schedules, customer correspondence, inspection records, and closeout documents.
Coordinate procurement of tools, testing equipment, rental equipment, materials, and subcontract services.
Review and resolve open purchase orders, project costs, invoices, and receivables.
Ensure maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Amteck quality standards.
Investigate customer concerns, project challenges, quality issues, and safety incidents while implementing corrective actions.
Provide leadership in promoting a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, professionalism, and customer success.
Communicate effectively with all internal departments and external stakeholders.

Position Requirements

Technical Expertise:

Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, industrial electrical equipment, motor control systems, switchgear, transformers, MCCs, panelboards, protective devices, and control systems.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B electrical maintenance requirements.
Strong knowledge of NFPA 70E, OSHA regulations, and electrical safety practices.
Knowledge of NETA testing procedures and electrical reliability principles.
Ability to interpret electrical one-line drawings, control schematics, equipment specifications, maintenance reports, and testing results.
Understanding of asset management, equipment criticality, risk assessment, reliability-centered maintenance, and predictive maintenance technologies.
Working knowledge of infrared thermography, power quality analysis, electrical testing, and condition-based maintenance practices.

Project Management Skills

Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.
Strong planning, scheduling, budgeting, and organizational skills.
Experience coordinating outages, shutdowns, maintenance events, and field personnel.
Ability to identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to establish priorities and delegate responsibilities effectively.

Customer Success & Communication

Exceptional customer relationship management skills.
Commitment to providing outstanding customer service and long-term value.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to confidently present maintenance findings and recommendations to maintenance personnel, engineering teams, plant leadership, and executive management.
Ability to communicate technical information in a clear and understandable manner.

Technology & Software

High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Experience with maintenance management software, project management systems, scheduling software, and mobile reporting tools.
Ability to analyze maintenance data and develop customer-facing reports.
Strong overall computer skills and ability to learn new software platforms quickly.

Safety & Compliance

Promote, enforce, and support all company safety policies and procedures.
Ensure all maintenance activities are conducted in accordance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, company policy, and customer requirements.
Demonstrate commitment to the belief that all incidents are preventable.
Foster a culture of safety excellence and continuous improvement.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success.
Works closely with Business Development Managers, Project Coordinators, Lead Technicians, Maintenance Technicians, Regional Operations Leadership, Engineering, Safety, and Executive Leadership.
Serves as the primary communication link between customers and the Preventive Maintenance Department.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 5-10 years of experience in industrial electrical maintenance, electrical service, reliability engineering, electrical testing, project management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing maintenance programs, service projects, or industrial operations.
Strong knowledge of electrical preventive maintenance principles and best practices.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, and applicable electrical codes.
Experience working within industrial manufacturing, processing, utility, or commercial facilities.
Ability to review and understand maintenance reports, testing data, and equipment condition assessments.
Strong financial awareness and understanding of project cost management.
Current valid driver's license.
Ability to travel as required to customer locations, approximately 50% maximum
Excellent organizational, leadership, and customer service skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment factors for this position will vary greatly based on customer facilities and project locations. Candidates must be comfortable working in manufacturing plants, processing facilities, utility environments, commercial facilities, and outdoor environments.

Travel may be required to support customer locations and project activities. Site visits may involve exposure to energized electrical equipment, industrial hazards, elevated work platforms, varying weather conditions, confined spaces, and extended walking throughout large facilities. Candidates must be capable of conducting facility assessments, participating in outage activities, attending customer meetings, and supporting field operations as necessary.

I
n 1977 Amteck was founded in Central Kentucky with the belief that growth only comes by listening and responding to both clients and employees. Four decades later, Amteck has grown from a small electrical contracting firm to a national leader in the design/build support electrical contracting industry. Amteck specializes in facility growth expansion initiatives of companies that operate in the manufacturing, industrial, process, food, and beverage, hospitality, healthcare, distribution facilities, and commercial and institutional sectors. The number one goal is the Safety of our Employees and maintaining our culture and core values: THE AMTECK WAY – SAFETY, QUALITY, & CUSTOMER SATISFACTION.

Using Thera PEAK� Products customers can better plan the development of their therapy, from discovery right through to commercialization. (Depending on team structure, this role may report to a Senior or Associate Director product manager).

Main Responsibilities:

Product Line Strategy

Overview:

Sentara is hiring a Senior Data Analyst!

This position is fully remote.

Overview

The Senior Data Analyst supports the Batch Reprocessing and Payment Integrity function by designing and delivering the reporting, dashboards, and analytical tooling that measure operational performance across the claims reprocessing lifecycle. Working across multiple claims adjudication platforms and the team's ticketing and data warehouse environments, this role turns raw claims and workflow data into reliable metrics on cycle time, turnaround, recovery volume, and queue health. The Senior Data Analyst partners with operations leadership to define complex reporting requirements, builds repeatable and auditable data pulls in place of manual one-off extracts, and contributes to data quality and stewardship so the team's operational numbers hold up under leadership and audit review. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone fluent in SQL and claims data, not a generalist business intelligence position.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst is the analytics owner for a healthcare claims reprocessing and payment integrity team operating across two health plan markets. The team handles overpayment recovery, claims reprocessing, provider contestment review, and the operational reporting that supports each. This role builds and maintains the data products the team and its leadership rely on to manage day-to-day work and to demonstrate performance against operational targets.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards and reports that track reprocessing cycle time, post-approval turnaround, queue and hold status, stalled or aging tickets, contestment volume, and recovery throughput.
Write and optimize complex SQL against multiple claims adjudication systems and an enterprise data platform, including queries that join claims data to ticketing and workflow data through established crosswalks.
Replace manual, ad-hoc extracts with documented, repeatable, and parameterized data pulls so that recurring reports are consistent and reproducible from one period to the next.
Translate operational questions from team leadership into clear reporting requirements, and document those requirements so the logic behind each metric is transparent and defensible.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to answer time-sensitive operational and prioritization questions, including high-dollar case identification and workload distribution across reviewers and analysts.
Support data quality and stewardship efforts: validate that source data ties out, identify and document data gaps or anomalies, and flag conditions that would make a metric unreliable before it reaches leadership.
Partner with IT and data platform teams on data access, source structure, and the migration of operational data off manual processes onto governed, auditable platforms.
Produce reporting that is appropriate for a regulated, audited environment, including clear sourcing and documentation of report logic, while keeping the role's outputs limited to operational status and analytics rather than financial estimates or accounting determinations.
Promote self-service reporting where appropriate by building reusable, well-documented data products rather than serving every request as a one-off.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. (Required)

Certification/Licensure

Relevant certification such as a coding credential (CPC), a Microsoft data or Power BI certification, or a SQL or database certification.

Experience

Five or more years of progressive data analysis experience, with at least two years working directly with healthcare claims, payer operations, or payment integrity data. (Required)
Demonstrated experience writing production-grade SQL against relational databases independently, not solely through a drag-and-drop reporting layer. (Required)
Advanced SQL, Data visualization and BI development, with hands-on Power BI experience
Python coding, data warehouse using Synapse
Exposure to workflow or ticketing systems and to joining workflow data to claims data.
Ability to gather and document reporting requirements and to explain the logic behind a metric to a non-technical operations audience.
Data Quality, Data Validation experience
Experience working with IT and Data teams
Experience with a claims adjudication platform (QNXT, Facets, or a comparable payer system) and with claims data structures such as claim, line, member eligibility, provider, and coordination of benefits.
Familiarity with operating in an ICFR or SOX regulated environment and producing reporting that supports audit and control requirements.
Familiarity with or hands-on use of AI and large language model tools

  Tätigkeitsbereich
Die Datenstelle der Rentenversicherung (DSRV) betreibt kundenorientiert die elektronische Kommunikation der Rentenversicherungsträger untereinander sowie zu den Versicherten und anderen Behörden. Mithilfe eines  roßen Vorhabens wird im Rahmen einer Programmstruktur, die 11 unterschiedliche IT-Projekte umfasst, an der Erneuerung der zentralen IT der DSRV gearbeitet. Die DSRV operiert aktuell noch auf der Basis historisch gewachsener IT-(Infra-) Strukturen und hat mit den umfassenden Modernisierungsmaßnahmen bereits begonnen. Das komplexe Vorhaben ist daher von zentraler Bedeutung, um maßgebliche Schritte für die Zukunftssicherung für die DSRV und damit auch für die DRV Bund vorzunehmen.

RapidClaims is a leader in AI-driven revenue cycle management
, transforming medical coding and revenue operations with cutting-edge technology. 
The company has raised $11 million in total funding

. 
Join us as we scale a cloud-native platform that runs transformer-based Large Language Models rigorously fine-tuned on millions of clinical notes and claims every month. You’ll engineer autonomous coding pipelines that parse ICD-10-CM, CPT® and HCPCS at lightning speed, deliver reimbursement insights with sub-second latency and >99 % accuracy, and tackle the deep-domain challenges that make clinical AI one of the hardest—and most rewarding—problems in tech.

Revenue Business Analyst- Job Overview

As a Revenue Cycle Business Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing, optimizing, and supporting end-to-end revenue cycle operations for US healthcare clients. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, Coding, and Operations, to translate business needs into actionable insights and scalable solutions. Ensure compliance with US healthcare regulations, payer guidelines, and coding standards (ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS).

Act as a bridge between business, operations, and technical teams to ensure successful delivery of solutions.

Collaborative, fast-paced, and growth-oriented work environment.

JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

SPAs NATO Allied Command Transformation Group within JOID provides capability development, portfolio management, program management, quality management, cost estimation analysis, standardization, reporting, software solutions and information management, and capability management support. We also provide an improved capability requirements capture process, including the generation, documentation and tracing of user requirements, with appropriate technical scrutiny, over the entire lifecycle of the requirements from capability definition through capability realization and capability usage.

We have a near-term need for a Program Analyst: Data Integration & Decision Support-Enabling Capabilities Portfolio to provide onsite support out of Norfolk, VA.

Responsibilities

The candidate will support the Enabling Capabilities Portfolio with an initial focus on Infrastructure Programs by providing hands-on expertise in data integration, data engineering, analytics, and decision support. Work closely with program managers, portfolio staff, analysts, data owners, and other stakeholders to identify priority decisions, information requirements, data gaps, and opportunities to improve program delivery through more effective use of data. Responsibilities include designing, developing, testing, and maintaining repeatable data integration processes; developing structured data models, common definitions, business rules, reference data, and quality controls; and creating digital data-collection applications and workflows that reduce reliance on spreadsheets, manual consolidation, and email-driven processes. Support the continued development and operational use of digital Management and Oversight Review (MOR) data-collection and decision-support solutions. D evelop dashboards, metrics, visualizations, analytical products, and other decision-support tools that provide greater visibility into program status, performance, schedules, resources, risks, dependencies, and emerging issues. Responsibilities will also include integrating program and portfolio information with authoritative NATO and enterprise data sources using approved databases, APIs, data services, structured file exchanges,and other available interfaces. Identify and address data-quality, ownership, lineage, governance, and authoritative-source issues while applying sound development and engineering practices to ensure solutions are reliable, reproducible, transparent, and auditable. D ocument data sources, models, transformations, business rules, analytical logic, assumptions, dependencies, operating procedures, and solution configurations to support long-term sustainment and reuse. Conduct user testing, incorporate stakeholder feedback, establish appropriate performance baselines, and evaluate improvements in areas such as data quality, timeliness, workflow efficiency, manual processing effort, and decision-making effectiveness. Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field; or 5+ years of directly relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree; relevant experience must include work in at least two of the following areas: data integration/data engineering, analytical programming, or business intelligence/analytics/decision-support development.

3+ years of experience within the last 5 years, including hands-on experience within the last 2 years, performing data integration or data engineering using relational databases, ETL/ELT, APIs, data pipelines, data services, structured data exchange, or comparable methods; must demonstrate at least one example of integrating data from two or more separately administered systems, databases, services, or authoritative data sources.
2+ years of experience within the last 5 years, including hands-on use within the last 2 years, using SQL against relational data sources and at least one qualifying analytical programming language such as Python, R, Scala, Julia, SAS, MATLAB, or Stata; candidates must provide at least one recent example demonstrating personal use of both SQL and a qualifying analytical programming language; DAX, Power Query M, VBA, Excel formulas, and spreadsheet macros do not satisfy the analytical programming requirement.
Demonstrated experience within the last 5 years personally designing or developing at least two structured digital data-collection, workflow, low-code/no-code, configured-application, or comparable solutions that reduced reliance on manual, email-driven, or spreadsheet-based processes; at least one solution must have been personally developed or materially enhanced within the last 3 years.
3+ years of experience within the last 5 years personally developing business intelligence products, analytical products, dashboards, metrics, visualizations, or comparable decision-support solutions; must demonstrate at least one personally developed product that was actively used by an identified program, portfolio, management, or operational user group to support business operations or decision-making.
Demonstrated hands-on experience within the last 5 years, including at least one example within the last 3 years, applying data modelling, data-quality, or data-governance practices to an operational data or analytical solution; experience must include practical application in at least two of the following areas: development of data models or relationships; development of data definitions, metadata, or common data standards; implementation of validation rules or data-quality controls; or implementation of data lineage, stewardship, or authoritative-source controls.
Demonstrated experience within the last 5 years documenting and transferring at least one data, analytical, or digital solution for continued operation or maintenance by another developer, colleague, support team, platform owner, or operational organization; must also demonstrate use within the last 3 years of Git or equivalent source control, platform-native versioned deployment/environment management, or a documented configuration baseline maintained under change control.
2+ years of experience within the last 5 years working directly with operational users, program personnel, managers, or decision makers to identify information or analytical requirements and communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, risks, or decision implications; candidates must demonstrate at least one example of personally eliciting a requirement and communicating the resulting analysis or decision-support information to the supported user or decision-maker group.

At QBE, we get to the heart of what matters for our customers. And we do it all with a human touch.

jobs.title: Cloud Security Manager - Azure Infrastructure & AI
jobs.description:
Deloitte Space is expanding flight-proven satellite cybersecurity capabilities and supporting managed services into the commercial space market. Building on flight heritage from Deloitte-1, this role will help scale cyber-resilient solutions for emerging space companies, satellite operators, primes, and large constellation operators.

The Lead Product Engineer / Architect will serve as the senior technical authority for the offering, working as a peer to the Lead Product Manager. This role will shape the technical vision, architecture, engineering standards, and delivery roadmap across cyber, software, hardware, AI, space, ground, and user segments. The ideal candidate can translate complex mission and security requirements into scalable, commercially viable solutions that can be deployed repeatably across clients.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Space Lead Product Engineer on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for:

Defining target architectures, interfaces, trust boundaries, and engineering patterns across space, ground, and user segments, with security by design embedded throughout.
Establishing engineering standards, release-readiness criteria, and architecture governance to support sound technical decisions and protect system integrity.
Leading cross-functional technical integration across cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering teams to align research, development, and production delivery.
Designing repeatable deployment approaches that support multiple client satellites, mission profiles, and constellation environments as the offering scales.
Overseeing system-level test strategy across integration, security validation, mission readiness, operational acceptance, and failure analysis.
Translating frameworks such as SPARTA, NIST, ATO, STIG, and CMMC into executable delivery controls and advising clients and executives on technical tradeoffs and product direction.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Defense & Resilience offering assists clients in defending against advanced threats by transforming security operations, monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence. Helps manage and protect dynamic attack surfaces and provides rapid crisis and cyber incident response, ensuring clients can be ready for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of experience delivering product engineering, solution architecture, systems architecture, or technical product leadership for cyber, aerospace, space, embedded, or mission-critical systems
Experience leading multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering through production deployment and operations
Experience designing secure architectures across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and embedded or space-based environments, including interface definition, trust boundaries, and failure mode analysis
Experience authoring reference architectures, design patterns, or technical standards adopted across multiple teams or client environments and implementing controls aligned to NIST, ATO, STIG, CMMC, or comparable frameworks
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience supporting commercial go-to-market activities for a product or platform, including pilots, co-development, or first-of-kind client deployments
Experience supporting satellite mission operations or aerospace delivery programs, including embedded or real-time system integration
Experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning models in constrained environments
Experience applying SPARTA threat frameworks to architecture, testing, or security design
Experience with one or more of the following: C, POSIX, real-time operating systems, Python, PyTorch, Docker, Grafana, MQTT, Node.js, GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, or containerized deployments
Active Secret or higher security clearance

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Overview

Data Analysis & Data Solutions

System Integration Analysis

Solution Design & Delivery Support

Review technical designs to ensure alignment with business requirements.
Participate in backlog refinement, sprint prioritization activities.

Testing, Validation & Production Support

Develop test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and System to System test plans and test cases.
Coordinate business testing activities and validate delivered functionality.
Support root cause analysis and resolution of production issues involving data or integrations.
Monitor post-implementation success and identify continuous improvement opportunities.

What You Will Be Doing

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Silicon Co-Design
jobs.description:
NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) sits at the intersection of architecture, silicon, systems, and manufacturing — where engineering judgment at the highest level drives real-world product outcomes at scale.

We are hiring a Senior TPM who doesn't just lead programs but shapes them: A Senior TPM who has owned SoC programs from architecture through tape-out, bring-up, and productization—not by coordinating meetings, but by owning outcomes, schedules, and trade-offs. They combine deep hands-on knowledge of bring-up and validation with the judgment to see integration risks across silicon, systems, and software, and they drive alignment across engineering, operations, and product without deferring hard calls. They operate effectively when requirements and architecture are still changing. They identify dependencies and misalignment early, before crises develop. They close risks with mitigation plans that engineers respect. They improve how the organization completes work after each program. They are credible on silicon hardware logistics (silicon, boards, peripherals), so validation and bring-up stay unblocked. The exceptional hire also uses AI deliberately: they have hands-on experience with AI-powered program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk, and dependency signals) and can tell what improves outcomes versus what adds noise. This role requires on-site teamwork in Santa Clara, a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Be Doing

Own program outcomes end-to-end — define and manage schedules, surface dependencies before they block work, and drive multi-functional alignment from architecture review through tape-out and bring-up; you’re accountable for delivery, not only oversight.
Lead through design complexity — take part in critical design reviews, flag scope risks early, resolve them with minimal disruption, and make trade-off calls others will depend on.
Be the connective tissue — act as the main technical link among silicon, systems, software, operations, and marketing; keep teams aligned on program goals and GTM needs, and catch misalignment before it hurts the program.
Drive risk to closure — find technical and schedule risks early, build mitigations with engineering, and move work forward with clarity and context, not only status.
Raise the execution bar — capture lessons from finished programs and put in place process changes that measurably improve speed, quality, and predictability on later programs.
Handle silicon hardware logistics — coordinate movement, tracking, and availability of silicon, boards, and peripherals so validation and bring-up stay unblocked.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience); a master’s is a plus
12+ years in technical roles, with at least 5 years in technical program management — ideally driving SoC programs from bring-up through productization
Deep, hands-on understanding of SoC bring-up, validation, and productization — you know the stages, what each involves, and what can go wrong
Ability to work across the silicon–system–software boundary — enough depth in each area to spot integration risks and drive fixes without having to be the expert on every technical question
Proven track record to run fast development cycles in uncertainty — you develop transparency instead of waiting for it
Communication that is precise, direct, and right-sized for the audience
On-site in Santa Clara, CA, a minimum of three days per week

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Used AI-style program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk flagging, dependency tracking) and can tell which tools help outcomes vs add noise
Experience working with AI/ML teams on inference infrastructure and aligning multi-functional work with go-to-market timing for AI-accelerated products
Experience with AI-assisted logistics tracking to speed bring-up and reduce manual efforts, including where those approaches stop being reliable
Can evaluate and help roll out new AI productivity tools (coding assistants, automated documentation) and make a clear case for what actually improves engineering velocity

new_jobs.description:
Interim Project Manager – D365 F&O

Groenlo, Netherlands

32 - 38 hrs

€ 110 - € 130

Hybrid

What are you going to do?

“Bring direction and momentum to an ERP transformation that prepares Nedap for its next stage of growth.”

Nedap is bringing supply chain and finance processes across its market groups together on one future-proof ERP platform. By phasing out legacy systems, we create clearer processes, more reliable data, and a stronger foundation for scale and future AI-enabled capabilities.

The direction and roadmap are in place. As our Interim ERP Project Manager, you bring structure, seniority, and momentum to a complex change program in which process, data, technology, and multiple stakeholders come together. You are a senior sparring partner for experienced professionals and leadership: you help the team stay focused on the outcomes that matter, ensure that dependencies, risks, and unresolved choices receive the attention they need, and lead decision-making and escalation towards the Steering Committee.

You do not need to redefine the content direction: we are replacing Navision with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) and aim to stay as close to the standard as possible. Within those boundaries, you are expected to critically test the existing roadmap and assumptions and, where needed, propose an alternative course. You turn priorities into practical next steps, make progress visible, and manage for results.

Start your application

Your responsibilities

Translate the existing roadmap into a clear delivery rhythm, with practical priorities, milestones, and follow-up - while identifying when assumptions, sequencing, or planning need to be adjusted.

Ensure open choices and bottlenecks reach the right people, push through when needed, and lead these topics effectively towards the Steering Committee.

Make progress, dependencies, risks, bottlenecks, and trade-offs visible, and steer towards the agreed result.

Align Finance, Operations, key users, IT, Microsoft, integration partners, and external logistics and warehousing parties around shared progress.

Work with business owners to identify optimization opportunities and ensure that process choices and customization deliver customer value within the F&O standard.

Your team

You will work within Nedap's IT General environment, alongside experienced ERP professionals and colleagues from across the organization. The team has the ERP expertise it needs; your contribution is senior project leadership: creating clarity, focus, and follow-through, connecting people, and leading the team through a critical delivery phase with a human approach.

You will work closely with business owners, leadership, key users, Microsoft, integration partners, and external parties connected to Nedap's processes and systems. The CFO is the sponsor; the Steering Committee consists of the CEO, CFO, IT Manager, and ERP implementation partner. You have mandate for day-to-day delivery, team leadership, and organizing execution. Changes in course, planning and budget, and decisions on process changes or customization investments are brought to the Steering Committee. You have the freedom to shape your approach and are expected to escalate and push through when progress requires it: four days per week, with at least three days at our Campus in Groenlo.

Our offer

What's in it for you?

This is an opportunity to lead a complex ERP transformation through its next phase and bring the direction already set through to a successful go-live. Success means more than putting Nedap NV fully operational on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations: processes transition smoothly, adoption is secured, and the project team reaches the finish line together with a strong, positive way of working.

An assignment expected to run for at least 9 months, and to continue as needed to complete this delivery phase successfully.
A commitment of four days per week throughout the assignment.
An hourly rate in line with the level of responsibility. We would like you to share your all-in rate (excluding VAT) with us when sending in your application.
A complex, international program in which your contribution is visible in progress, decision quality, organizational adoption, and the way the project team works together.
We work based on trust, ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and space. You bring expertise, an independent perspective, and human leadership. You stand behind your team, take and give space when needed, celebrate successes, and make sure the organization is well guided through choices, pace, and change.

All terms of employment

Required Skills

You enjoy bringing order and momentum to complex programs and act as a senior sparring partner for business and IT. You understand the connection between business processes, data, and technology, without needing to be the technical or functional specialist yourself. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and know how to help people move from discussion to decision and execution. You manage for results, while also managing the pace the team and organization can sustain.

Your experience includes:

Over 10 years of experience leading complex ERP implementations or transitions, preferably involving Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), in a role where you also led senior stakeholders and decision-making.
Bringing an existing ERP roadmap or implementation program through a critical delivery phase, including identifying risks and proposing well-founded course changes when needed.
Structuring planning, dependencies, risks, issues, and decision-making across multiple workstreams, with clear escalation to governance when decisions fall outside your mandate.
Managing stakeholders in a complex environment involving business teams, IT, implementation partners, and external integration parties.
Enough technical and architectural understanding to recognize risks and unnecessary customization, challenge constructively, and work with ERP specialists and partners to protect customer value within the F&O standard.

Good to know: this is an independent contractor assignment for four days per week, starting as soon as possible. The assignment is expected to run for at least nine months and to continue until Nedap NV is successfully live and fully operational on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. You will be present at our Campus in Groenlo at least three days per week.

Global CI is an award-winning 30-year IT Services company founded on the principles of providing high-quality, value-added technology consulting services. Job Description

Position Description    

CGI Federal is seeking an experienced ServiceNow Project Manager / Product Owner to help lead enterprise transformation initiatives ServiceNow Program Office. This role is responsible for managing product roadmaps, supporting Agile delivery teams, and ensuring high-quality implementation of ServiceNow capabilities across multiple business areas. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in ServiceNow Program Office support, requirements definition, enterprise workflow design, and cross-functional coordination in a federal environment.

***This position is located in our Baltimore, MD office; candidate must be willing to work onsite a minimum of 3 days / week***

Key Required Skills     

Candidates must have ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience
8+ years of experience in IT project or product management, with over all 8+ years of experience and 4+ years focused on ServiceNow.
Must have strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Experience with leading stakeholder requirements analysis sessions and eliciting requirements from multiple stakeholders
Extensive hands on experience with the ServiceNow platfrom from a development perspective
Strong understanding of ServiceNow modules including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM, CMDB/CSDM, and Service Portal.
Demonstrated experience managing Agile delivery teams and working with cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong analytical, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements.
Experience delivering enterprise initiatives within government or large-scale organizations.

Desired Skills    

ServiceNow certifications such as: Certified System Administrator; Certified Implementation Specialist (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, SPM)
PMP, SAFe PO/PM, Scrum Master, or similar Agile certification
Experience with enterprise architecture, data modeling, and workflow automation.
Familiarity with federal IT governance, accessibility standards, and security frameworks.

Future Roles and Responsibilities 

Serve as the Project Manager / Product Owner, defining vision, roadmap, and priorities for key ServiceNow capabilities.
Support planning and delivery of ServiceNow enhancements and enterprise initiatives across areas such as IT Service Management (ITSM), Enterprise Architect (EA), IT Asset Management (ITAM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)
Facilitate Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, stand-ups, demos, and retrospectives.
Conduct requirements sessions, interviews, workshops, and process mapping with stakeholders across the organization.
Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows, and feature documentation.
Collaborate closely with architects and developers to ensure implementation aligns with business needs.
Recommend process improvements, workflow optimizations, automation opportunities, and user experience enhancements.
Support change management activities including communications, training materials, knowledge articles, and stakeholder readiness.
Partner with analytics teams to create dashboards, KPIs, and reporting to track performance and adoption.
Maintain clear documentation including requirements, design artifacts, release notes, training guides, and testing results.
Ensure all platform enhancements comply with federal security, accessibility, and data governance requirements (e.g., Section 508, NIST, FedRAMP).

Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and short & long-term disability insurance + health savings account
Matching 401k retirement plan + IRA's and Roth IRA's
Generous paid time off and paid holidays
Employee recruitment/referral bonus
Paid community service hours
