At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

The role is part of the In-Space Systems business unit, which is focused on addressing two of the most compelling challenges in spaceflight today: space infrastructure and increasing mobility on-orbit.

We are a diverse team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly committed to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight. Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth.

This role is part of the Business Operations and Efficiency organization, which supports our Blue National Security business unit. Our mission is to maximize operational productivity and enable data-driven decision-making across Blue Origin through intelligent automation, analytics infrastructure, and operational excellence that allows teams to accomplish more with existing resources.

As part of a hardworking team of diverse specialists and analysts, you will work as a Senior Project Manager, Secure Facility Expansion responsible for leading the end-to-end planning, design, construction, and accreditation of multiple classified facilities across the country. You will serve as the primary project management lead for a significant multi-site secure facility expansion program, coordinating across internal stakeholders, external construction managers, architects, and government accrediting officials to deliver compliant, on-schedule, and cost-effective facilities. This is a high-visibility program with direct executive sponsorship and meaningful impact on Blue Origin's ability to pursue and execute national security missions.

We are seeking an individual with excellent project management, communication, and stakeholder leadership skills who can thrive in a fast-paced, multi-site construction environment. You will share in the team's impact on national security mission enablement, facilities excellence, and Blue Origin's long-term classified infrastructure strategy. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end project management for a multi-site secure facility construction program, including planning, design, construction execution, and government accreditation across multiple simultaneous locations
Manage and report on a Master Schedule spanning all active construction sites, tracking parallel milestones and critical path items across each location
Own program cost management and budget tracking, including cost estimate maintenance, change order management, contractor invoice review, and cost-to-complete forecasting
Serve as the primary owner's representative in weekly OAC (Owner-Architect-Contractor) meetings at each site, coordinating between Blue Origin internal teams, general contractors, architects, and specialty subcontractors
Coordinate the government accreditation process in close partnership with Security and IT teams, including Construction Security Plan submittals and sponsoring agency coordination
Identify, track, and resolve program risks, issues, and dependencies across all sites; escalate appropriately to executive stakeholders
Develop and maintain program status reports and executive briefings for senior leadership

Qualifications

BA/BS in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or related discipline
5+ years of project management experience in facilities construction, including direct responsibility for construction schedules, budgets, and contractor management
Demonstrated experience managing multi-site or multi-phase construction programs simultaneously
Strong proficiency in cost management and budget tracking for construction projects, including change order management and cost forecasting
Experience leading Owner-Architect-Contractor (OAC) or similar construction coordination meetings
Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder environments including internal leadership, external contractors, and government or regulatory bodies
Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to produce clear executive-level status reports and briefings
Travel up to 50% required to support active construction sites across multiple U.S. locations
Must be a U.S. citizen
Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret / SCI security clearance

Desired

Experience project managing ICD-705 compliant SCIF or SAPF construction, including familiarity with Construction Security Plans (CSPs) and government Accrediting Official (AO) coordination
Familiarity with TEMPEST, acoustic (STC), and physical security requirements for classified facilities
Active Top Secret / SCI security clearance
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification or equivalent
Experience in aerospace, defense, or national security industry environments
Familiarity with ICD-705 or related Intelligence Community Directives governing secure facility construction

Base Pay Range For

VA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25 CO applicants is $123,611.00 - $173,054.70 WA applicants is $134,434.00 - $188,207.25

Other Site Ranges May Differ

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Background Check

Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.

Amteck is a Top 50 electrical contractor, and we are looking to add a Project Manager - Preventive Maintenance to our Dyersburg team!

Primary Role

The Preventive Maintenance Project Manager (PMPM) is ultimately responsible for the successful planning, execution, quality, customer satisfaction, and financial performance of assigned electrical preventive maintenance programs and related service projects. This position leads all aspects of recurring maintenance agreements, site audits, arc flash studies, infrared inspections, testing services, corrective maintenance recommendations, outage coordination, and customer success activities.

The PMPM serves as the primary point of contact between the customer and Amteck and is responsible for developing long-term partnerships that improve electrical reliability, safety, compliance, and operational performance. This position requires strong business management skills, leadership ability, technical knowledge of electrical systems, excellent communication skills, and a thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, NETA standards, OEM maintenance requirements, and industrial maintenance practices.

This position reports to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success and works closely with Operations, Service, Engineering, Business Development, Safety, and Executive Leadership teams.

Responsibilities

Manage all aspects of assigned preventive maintenance programs, service agreements, and maintenance-related projects from initiation through completion.
Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts and maintain regular communication regarding project status, findings, recommendations, and future opportunities.
Develop and maintain strong customer relationships that result in long-term partnerships and recurring maintenance agreements.
Coordinate annual maintenance schedules with customers to ensure inspections, testing, outages, shutdowns, and maintenance events are completed on time.
Lead project planning activities, including scope development, manpower planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, reporting, and resource allocation.
Review customer facilities, electrical infrastructure, and operational requirements to develop maintenance strategies that improve equipment reliability and reduce risk.
Coordinate and facilitate site audits, asset inventories, equipment criticality assessments, and risk evaluations.
Work closely with Business Development personnel to transition opportunities into successful project execution.
Manage project costs, labor utilization, material expenditures, subcontractors, and financial performance to achieve departmental objectives.
Create and maintain project schedules while coordinating resources across multiple customer locations.
Review preventive maintenance reports and inspection findings for technical accuracy, consistency, and quality.
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, NETA standards, OEM recommendations, and customer-specific safety requirements.
Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, customer presentations, closeout meetings, and internal project reviews.
Coordinate outage planning and shutdown activities with customers and field leadership.
Work directly with Lead Technicians and Maintenance Technicians to establish project expectations, priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
Mentor and develop Maintenance Leads, Technicians, and Project Coordinators.
Assist with workforce planning and manpower forecasting for maintenance programs and service agreements.
Review and approve maintenance scopes, quotes, corrective action plans, and recommendations before submission to customers.
Identify opportunities for additional maintenance services, corrective repairs, system upgrades, engineering studies, and reliability improvements.
Support development and implementation of department standards, processes, templates, reporting tools, and best practices.
Review and analyze maintenance data, equipment condition information, testing results, and asset health indicators to identify trends and risks.
Assist customers with maintenance budgeting and capital planning efforts by identifying future maintenance and reliability needs.
Manage project documentation including maintenance reports, action item logs, schedules, customer correspondence, inspection records, and closeout documents.
Coordinate procurement of tools, testing equipment, rental equipment, materials, and subcontract services.
Review and resolve open purchase orders, project costs, invoices, and receivables.
Ensure maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with Amteck quality standards.
Investigate customer concerns, project challenges, quality issues, and safety incidents while implementing corrective actions.
Provide leadership in promoting a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, professionalism, and customer success.
Communicate effectively with all internal departments and external stakeholders.

Position Requirements

Technical Expertise:

Strong knowledge of electrical distribution systems, industrial electrical equipment, motor control systems, switchgear, transformers, MCCs, panelboards, protective devices, and control systems.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B electrical maintenance requirements.
Strong knowledge of NFPA 70E, OSHA regulations, and electrical safety practices.
Knowledge of NETA testing procedures and electrical reliability principles.
Ability to interpret electrical one-line drawings, control schematics, equipment specifications, maintenance reports, and testing results.
Understanding of asset management, equipment criticality, risk assessment, reliability-centered maintenance, and predictive maintenance technologies.
Working knowledge of infrared thermography, power quality analysis, electrical testing, and condition-based maintenance practices.

Project Management Skills

Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, schedules, and priorities simultaneously.
Strong planning, scheduling, budgeting, and organizational skills.
Experience coordinating outages, shutdowns, maintenance events, and field personnel.
Ability to identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to establish priorities and delegate responsibilities effectively.

Customer Success & Communication

Exceptional customer relationship management skills.
Commitment to providing outstanding customer service and long-term value.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to confidently present maintenance findings and recommendations to maintenance personnel, engineering teams, plant leadership, and executive management.
Ability to communicate technical information in a clear and understandable manner.

Technology & Software

High proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Experience with maintenance management software, project management systems, scheduling software, and mobile reporting tools.
Ability to analyze maintenance data and develop customer-facing reports.
Strong overall computer skills and ability to learn new software platforms quickly.

Safety & Compliance

Promote, enforce, and support all company safety policies and procedures.
Ensure all maintenance activities are conducted in accordance with OSHA, NFPA 70E, company policy, and customer requirements.
Demonstrate commitment to the belief that all incidents are preventable.
Foster a culture of safety excellence and continuous improvement.

Reporting Relationships

Reports directly to the Director of Preventive Maintenance & Customer Success.
Works closely with Business Development Managers, Project Coordinators, Lead Technicians, Maintenance Technicians, Regional Operations Leadership, Engineering, Safety, and Executive Leadership.
Serves as the primary communication link between customers and the Preventive Maintenance Department.

Minimum Qualifications

Minimum 5-10 years of experience in industrial electrical maintenance, electrical service, reliability engineering, electrical testing, project management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience managing maintenance programs, service projects, or industrial operations.
Strong knowledge of electrical preventive maintenance principles and best practices.
Thorough understanding of NFPA 70B, NFPA 70E, OSHA requirements, and applicable electrical codes.
Experience working within industrial manufacturing, processing, utility, or commercial facilities.
Ability to review and understand maintenance reports, testing data, and equipment condition assessments.
Strong financial awareness and understanding of project cost management.
Current valid driver's license.
Ability to travel as required to customer locations, approximately 50% maximum
Excellent organizational, leadership, and customer service skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

The physical demands and work environment factors for this position will vary greatly based on customer facilities and project locations. Candidates must be comfortable working in manufacturing plants, processing facilities, utility environments, commercial facilities, and outdoor environments.

Travel may be required to support customer locations and project activities. Site visits may involve exposure to energized electrical equipment, industrial hazards, elevated work platforms, varying weather conditions, confined spaces, and extended walking throughout large facilities. Candidates must be capable of conducting facility assessments, participating in outage activities, attending customer meetings, and supporting field operations as necessary.

I
n 1977 Amteck was founded in Central Kentucky with the belief that growth only comes by listening and responding to both clients and employees. Four decades later, Amteck has grown from a small electrical contracting firm to a national leader in the design/build support electrical contracting industry. Amteck specializes in facility growth expansion initiatives of companies that operate in the manufacturing, industrial, process, food, and beverage, hospitality, healthcare, distribution facilities, and commercial and institutional sectors. The number one goal is the Safety of our Employees and maintaining our culture and core values: THE AMTECK WAY – SAFETY, QUALITY, & CUSTOMER SATISFACTION.

Overview:

Sentara is hiring a Senior Data Analyst!

This position is fully remote.

Overview

The Senior Data Analyst supports the Batch Reprocessing and Payment Integrity function by designing and delivering the reporting, dashboards, and analytical tooling that measure operational performance across the claims reprocessing lifecycle. Working across multiple claims adjudication platforms and the team's ticketing and data warehouse environments, this role turns raw claims and workflow data into reliable metrics on cycle time, turnaround, recovery volume, and queue health. The Senior Data Analyst partners with operations leadership to define complex reporting requirements, builds repeatable and auditable data pulls in place of manual one-off extracts, and contributes to data quality and stewardship so the team's operational numbers hold up under leadership and audit review. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone fluent in SQL and claims data, not a generalist business intelligence position.

Job Description

The Senior Data Analyst is the analytics owner for a healthcare claims reprocessing and payment integrity team operating across two health plan markets. The team handles overpayment recovery, claims reprocessing, provider contestment review, and the operational reporting that supports each. This role builds and maintains the data products the team and its leadership rely on to manage day-to-day work and to demonstrate performance against operational targets.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain operational dashboards and reports that track reprocessing cycle time, post-approval turnaround, queue and hold status, stalled or aging tickets, contestment volume, and recovery throughput.
Write and optimize complex SQL against multiple claims adjudication systems and an enterprise data platform, including queries that join claims data to ticketing and workflow data through established crosswalks.
Replace manual, ad-hoc extracts with documented, repeatable, and parameterized data pulls so that recurring reports are consistent and reproducible from one period to the next.
Translate operational questions from team leadership into clear reporting requirements, and document those requirements so the logic behind each metric is transparent and defensible.
Conduct ad-hoc analysis to answer time-sensitive operational and prioritization questions, including high-dollar case identification and workload distribution across reviewers and analysts.
Support data quality and stewardship efforts: validate that source data ties out, identify and document data gaps or anomalies, and flag conditions that would make a metric unreliable before it reaches leadership.
Partner with IT and data platform teams on data access, source structure, and the migration of operational data off manual processes onto governed, auditable platforms.
Produce reporting that is appropriate for a regulated, audited environment, including clear sourcing and documentation of report logic, while keeping the role's outputs limited to operational status and analytics rather than financial estimates or accounting determinations.
Promote self-service reporting where appropriate by building reusable, well-documented data products rather than serving every request as a one-off.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. (Required)

Certification/Licensure

Relevant certification such as a coding credential (CPC), a Microsoft data or Power BI certification, or a SQL or database certification.

Experience

Five or more years of progressive data analysis experience, with at least two years working directly with healthcare claims, payer operations, or payment integrity data. (Required)
Demonstrated experience writing production-grade SQL against relational databases independently, not solely through a drag-and-drop reporting layer. (Required)
Advanced SQL, Data visualization and BI development, with hands-on Power BI experience
Python coding, data warehouse using Synapse
Exposure to workflow or ticketing systems and to joining workflow data to claims data.
Ability to gather and document reporting requirements and to explain the logic behind a metric to a non-technical operations audience.
Data Quality, Data Validation experience
Experience working with IT and Data teams
Experience with a claims adjudication platform (QNXT, Facets, or a comparable payer system) and with claims data structures such as claim, line, member eligibility, provider, and coordination of benefits.
Familiarity with operating in an ICFR or SOX regulated environment and producing reporting that supports audit and control requirements.
Familiarity with or hands-on use of AI and large language model tools

new_jobs.title: Cloud Security Manager - Azure Infrastructure & AI
new_jobs.description:
Deloitte Space is expanding flight-proven satellite cybersecurity capabilities and supporting managed services into the commercial space market. Building on flight heritage from Deloitte-1, this role will help scale cyber-resilient solutions for emerging space companies, satellite operators, primes, and large constellation operators.

The Lead Product Engineer / Architect will serve as the senior technical authority for the offering, working as a peer to the Lead Product Manager. This role will shape the technical vision, architecture, engineering standards, and delivery roadmap across cyber, software, hardware, AI, space, ground, and user segments. The ideal candidate can translate complex mission and security requirements into scalable, commercially viable solutions that can be deployed repeatably across clients.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/01/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Space Lead Product Engineer on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for:

Defining target architectures, interfaces, trust boundaries, and engineering patterns across space, ground, and user segments, with security by design embedded throughout.
Establishing engineering standards, release-readiness criteria, and architecture governance to support sound technical decisions and protect system integrity.
Leading cross-functional technical integration across cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering teams to align research, development, and production delivery.
Designing repeatable deployment approaches that support multiple client satellites, mission profiles, and constellation environments as the offering scales.
Overseeing system-level test strategy across integration, security validation, mission readiness, operational acceptance, and failure analysis.
Translating frameworks such as SPARTA, NIST, ATO, STIG, and CMMC into executable delivery controls and advising clients and executives on technical tradeoffs and product direction.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Defense & Resilience offering assists clients in defending against advanced threats by transforming security operations, monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence. Helps manage and protect dynamic attack surfaces and provides rapid crisis and cyber incident response, ensuring clients can be ready for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree
10+ years of experience delivering product engineering, solution architecture, systems architecture, or technical product leadership for cyber, aerospace, space, embedded, or mission-critical systems
Experience leading multidisciplinary delivery teams spanning cyber, software, hardware, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering through production deployment and operations
Experience designing secure architectures across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and embedded or space-based environments, including interface definition, trust boundaries, and failure mode analysis
Experience authoring reference architectures, design patterns, or technical standards adopted across multiple teams or client environments and implementing controls aligned to NIST, ATO, STIG, CMMC, or comparable frameworks
Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience supporting commercial go-to-market activities for a product or platform, including pilots, co-development, or first-of-kind client deployments
Experience supporting satellite mission operations or aerospace delivery programs, including embedded or real-time system integration
Experience deploying artificial intelligence or machine learning models in constrained environments
Experience applying SPARTA threat frameworks to architecture, testing, or security design
Experience with one or more of the following: C, POSIX, real-time operating systems, Python, PyTorch, Docker, Grafana, MQTT, Node.js, GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, or containerized deployments
Active Secret or higher security clearance

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 to $265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Silicon Co-Design
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA's Silicon Co-Design Group (SCG) sits at the intersection of architecture, silicon, systems, and manufacturing — where engineering judgment at the highest level drives real-world product outcomes at scale.

We are hiring a Senior TPM who doesn't just lead programs but shapes them: A Senior TPM who has owned SoC programs from architecture through tape-out, bring-up, and productization—not by coordinating meetings, but by owning outcomes, schedules, and trade-offs. They combine deep hands-on knowledge of bring-up and validation with the judgment to see integration risks across silicon, systems, and software, and they drive alignment across engineering, operations, and product without deferring hard calls. They operate effectively when requirements and architecture are still changing. They identify dependencies and misalignment early, before crises develop. They close risks with mitigation plans that engineers respect. They improve how the organization completes work after each program. They are credible on silicon hardware logistics (silicon, boards, peripherals), so validation and bring-up stay unblocked. The exceptional hire also uses AI deliberately: they have hands-on experience with AI-powered program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk, and dependency signals) and can tell what improves outcomes versus what adds noise. This role requires on-site teamwork in Santa Clara, a minimum of three days per week.

What You'll Be Doing

Own program outcomes end-to-end — define and manage schedules, surface dependencies before they block work, and drive multi-functional alignment from architecture review through tape-out and bring-up; you’re accountable for delivery, not only oversight.
Lead through design complexity — take part in critical design reviews, flag scope risks early, resolve them with minimal disruption, and make trade-off calls others will depend on.
Be the connective tissue — act as the main technical link among silicon, systems, software, operations, and marketing; keep teams aligned on program goals and GTM needs, and catch misalignment before it hurts the program.
Drive risk to closure — find technical and schedule risks early, build mitigations with engineering, and move work forward with clarity and context, not only status.
Raise the execution bar — capture lessons from finished programs and put in place process changes that measurably improve speed, quality, and predictability on later programs.
Handle silicon hardware logistics — coordinate movement, tracking, and availability of silicon, boards, and peripherals so validation and bring-up stay unblocked.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience); a master’s is a plus
12+ years in technical roles, with at least 5 years in technical program management — ideally driving SoC programs from bring-up through productization
Deep, hands-on understanding of SoC bring-up, validation, and productization — you know the stages, what each involves, and what can go wrong
Ability to work across the silicon–system–software boundary — enough depth in each area to spot integration risks and drive fixes without having to be the expert on every technical question
Proven track record to run fast development cycles in uncertainty — you develop transparency instead of waiting for it
Communication that is precise, direct, and right-sized for the audience
On-site in Santa Clara, CA, a minimum of three days per week

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Used AI-style program management tools (e.g., automated status, risk flagging, dependency tracking) and can tell which tools help outcomes vs add noise
Experience working with AI/ML teams on inference infrastructure and aligning multi-functional work with go-to-market timing for AI-accelerated products
Experience with AI-assisted logistics tracking to speed bring-up and reduce manual efforts, including where those approaches stop being reliable
Can evaluate and help roll out new AI productivity tools (coding assistants, automated documentation) and make a clear case for what actually improves engineering velocity
